memorize.usageZh: 及物动词，表示把信息完整记牢，后接名词或名词短语：memorize words / a poem / the lyrics。比 remember 更强调刻意背诵。常见搭配 try to memorize, memorize by heart。名词 memorization 偏正式。

examples.sentence: Mia memorizes five new words after dinner.
examples.trans: 米娅晚饭后熟记五个新单词。

examples.sentence: He memorizes the bus numbers so he will not get lost.
examples.trans: 他把公交车号背下来，免得迷路。

examples.sentence: Before the concert, she memorized every line of the song.
examples.trans: 音乐会前，她把歌词每一句都背熟了。

examples.sentence: Rather than memorizing isolated facts, he linked each date to a story.
examples.trans: 他没有孤立地背事实，而是把每个日期连到一个故事上。

examples.sentence: Athletes who memorize the route in daylight still hesitate in fog.
examples.trans: 白天把路线背下来的运动员，在雾里仍会犹豫。

examples.sentence: To memorize a speech is not the same as being able to answer unexpected questions.
examples.trans: 把演讲背下来，并不等于能应对突如其来的提问。

effective.usageZh: 形容词，表示能达到预期效果，常修饰 method, way, strategy, treatment。be effective in doing / against sth。副词 effectively；名词 effectiveness。反义 ineffective。比 useful 更强调“真的起作用”。

examples.sentence: This short walk is an effective way to wake up.
examples.trans: 短短散步是叫醒自己的有效办法。

examples.sentence: A clear timetable is more effective than last-minute panic.
examples.trans: 清晰的时间表比临时慌乱更有效。

examples.sentence: The new filter proved effective against the kitchen smoke.
examples.trans: 新过滤网对厨房油烟很有效。

examples.sentence: What looks effective on paper may fail when the team is tired.
examples.trans: 纸面上有效的方案，团队疲惫时可能失灵。

examples.sentence: An effective apology names the harm and offers a concrete repair.
examples.trans: 有效的道歉会点明伤害，并给出具体补救。

examples.sentence: Campaigns remain effective only while incentives and enforcement move together.
examples.trans: 只有激励与执行同步，宣传才会持续有效。

keen.usageZh: 形容词，表示热切、渴望。be keen on (doing) sth 热衷于；be keen to do 急切想做。也可修饰感官：keen eyesight 敏锐视力。比较级 keener。勿与 kind 混淆。

examples.sentence: Ben is keen on football after school.
examples.trans: 本放学后很爱踢足球。

examples.sentence: She is keen to help her little brother with maths.
examples.trans: 她很想帮弟弟做数学。

examples.sentence: Once he grew keen on cooking, the kitchen never stayed quiet.
examples.trans: 他迷上做饭后，厨房再也安静不下来。

examples.sentence: Investors remain keen on cities that protect old markets.
examples.trans: 投资者仍看好保护老市场的城市。

examples.sentence: A keen observer notices the pause before someone agrees.
examples.trans: 敏锐的观察者会注意到别人答应前的停顿。

examples.sentence: However keen the board is on expansion, cash flow still sets the limit.
examples.trans: 无论董事会多么热衷扩张，现金流仍划定上限。

patient.usageZh: 形容词：有耐心的，be/stay/remain patient with sb。也可作可数名词：病人 a patient。副词 patiently。名词 patience 为不可数。

examples.sentence: Grandma is patient when I tie my shoes slowly.
examples.trans: 我慢慢系鞋带时，奶奶很有耐心。

examples.sentence: Please be patient with the new puppy; he is still learning.
examples.trans: 请对新小狗有耐心，它还在学。

examples.sentence: The nurse stayed patient even when the queue grew long.
examples.trans: 队伍变长时，护士依然保持耐心。

examples.sentence: A patient editor waits for the right verb instead of forcing a loud one.
examples.trans: 有耐心的编辑会等那个恰当的动词，而不是硬塞一个响亮的。

examples.sentence: Being patient with a stalled project is not the same as ignoring its delays.
examples.trans: 对停滞的项目有耐心，并不等于无视它的拖延。

examples.sentence: The clinic's newest patient asked quietly whether the wait would last another hour.
examples.trans: 诊所里最新来的病人轻声问，还要再等一个小时吗。

partner.usageZh: 可数名词：一起做事的人。language partner 语伴，business partner 生意伙伴，dance partner 舞伴。动词 partner (with) 与……搭档。复数 partners。

examples.sentence: My partner in the game passes the ball to me.
examples.trans: 游戏里的搭档把球传给我。

examples.sentence: She found a language partner to practise French on Sundays.
examples.trans: 她找了个语伴，周日练习法语。

examples.sentence: The two partners shared the cost of the small bakery.
examples.trans: 两个合伙人分摊了小面包店的费用。

examples.sentence: A research partner who challenges your data is more useful than one who only nods.
examples.trans: 会质疑你数据的研究搭档，比只会点头的更有用。

examples.sentence: The museum partnered with local guides to open evening tours.
examples.trans: 博物馆与本地向导合作，开通了夜间游览。

examples.sentence: When a partnership rests only on profit, trust tends to thin out first.
examples.trans: 合伙若只靠利润维系，信任往往最先变薄。

stick.usageZh: 动词：stick to a plan/promise 坚持；stick to it 坚持做下去。也可表示粘贴 stick a stamp。名词 stick 棍子。过去式 stuck。

examples.sentence: Stick to the path or you may get lost.
examples.trans: 沿着小路走，不然可能迷路。

examples.sentence: If you stick to your piano practice, the song will come.
examples.trans: 如果你坚持练琴，这首歌就会出来。

examples.sentence: She stuck to her decision even when friends chose an easier trail.
examples.trans: 朋友们选了更轻松的小路，她仍坚持自己的决定。

examples.sentence: Teams that stick to a messy process rarely notice better tools.
examples.trans: 死守混乱流程的团队，很少注意到更好的工具。

examples.sentence: He stuck the notice on the fridge so nobody would miss the time.
examples.trans: 他把通知贴在冰箱上，免得有人错过时间。

examples.sentence: To stick to a principle is harder when the cheaper option is sitting in the same room.
examples.trans: 更便宜的选项就在同一间屋里时，坚持原则更难。

encouragement.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示给人信心的话语或行动。give/offer/need encouragement。动词 encourage sb to do。形容词 encouraging。反义 discouragement。

examples.sentence: Dad's smile was enough encouragement for me.
examples.trans: 爸爸的微笑对我来说就是鼓励。

examples.sentence: A little encouragement helped her finish the long jump.
examples.trans: 一点点鼓励帮她完成了跳远。

examples.sentence: The coach's encouragement kept the tired runners moving.
examples.trans: 教练的鼓励让疲惫的跑者继续向前。

examples.sentence: Public encouragement means little if private feedback is cruel.
examples.trans: 私下反馈很刻薄时，公开的鼓励意义不大。

examples.sentence: She wrote notes of encouragement on the inside of every lunch box.
examples.trans: 她在每个午餐盒内侧都写了鼓励的话。

examples.sentence: Encouragement that ignores real obstacles can sound like pressure in a softer voice.
examples.trans: 忽视真实困难的鼓励，听起来像更轻声的施压。

confidence.usageZh: 不可数名词：自信、把握。build/gain/lose confidence；have confidence in sb；with confidence。形容词 confident；副词 confidently。

examples.sentence: I spoke with confidence after I practised twice.
examples.trans: 练了两遍后，我说话有信心了。

examples.sentence: Her confidence grew when the first pancake came out round.
examples.trans: 第一张饼摊圆了，她的信心就长起来了。

examples.sentence: He lost confidence for a week after missing the open goal.
examples.trans: 空门没踢进后，他有一周都没了信心。

examples.sentence: Confidence without preparation is just volume.
examples.trans: 没有准备的自信，不过是音量。

examples.sentence: The intern answered the client confidently, then checked the numbers again.
examples.trans: 实习生自信地答复了客户，然后又核对了一遍数字。

examples.sentence: Markets treat sudden confidence as a signal, whether or not the data can carry it.
examples.trans: 市场把突然出现的信心当作信号，不管数据是否撑得住。

translation.usageZh: 可作不可数（翻译行为）或可数（一篇译文）。the translation of a poem；do translation。动词 translate；名词 translator。

examples.sentence: This translation of the joke is still funny.
examples.trans: 这个笑话的译文仍然好笑。

examples.sentence: She did a careful translation of the recipe from Italian.
examples.trans: 她把意大利食谱仔细译成了中文。

examples.sentence: A word-for-word translation missed the warmth of the original letter.
examples.trans: 逐字翻译丢掉了原信里的温度。

examples.sentence: Good translation carries tone, not only dictionary meaning.
examples.trans: 好的翻译带走语气，而不只是词典义。

examples.sentence: The museum printed a translation beside every faded inscription.
examples.trans: 博物馆在每段褪色铭文旁都印了译文。

examples.sentence: What resists translation often reveals where two cultures draw different lines.
examples.trans: 难以翻译之处，往往暴露两种文化划界的不同。

intermediate.usageZh: 形容词：介于初级与高级之间。intermediate course/level/learner。名词 an intermediate 中级学习者。副词 intermediately 少用。

examples.sentence: This book is for intermediate readers, not beginners.
examples.trans: 这本书给中级读者，不是给初学者。

examples.sentence: After one year she moved from beginner to intermediate class.
examples.trans: 一年后她从初级班升到中级班。

examples.sentence: The trail has an intermediate section with loose stones.
examples.trans: 这条小路有一段中等难度、石头松动的路。

examples.sentence: Intermediate learners often understand more than they dare to say.
examples.trans: 中级学习者常常听得懂的比敢说的多。

examples.sentence: The lab hired an intermediate technician who could already calibrate the meter.
examples.trans: 实验室雇了一名已会校准仪表的中级技术员。

examples.sentence: An intermediate stage of reform can look messy while old rules and new ones overlap.
examples.trans: 改革的中间阶段可能显得乱，因为新旧规则叠在一起。

advanced.usageZh: 形容词：水平高或技术先进。advanced learner/course/technology。动词 advance；名词 advance/advancement。反义 basic/elementary。

examples.sentence: The advanced class reads longer stories.
examples.trans: 高级班读更长的故事。

examples.sentence: His advanced camera takes clear pictures at night.
examples.trans: 他的高级相机夜里也能拍清楚。

examples.sentence: She joined an advanced workshop on map-making.
examples.trans: 她参加了制图高级研习班。

examples.sentence: Advanced tools do not replace the need to ask a better question.
examples.trans: 先进工具替代不了提出更好问题的需要。

examples.sentence: The hospital installed an advanced scanner that shortened waiting times.
examples.trans: 医院装了先进扫描仪，缩短了等候时间。

examples.sentence: What counts as advanced in one decade becomes ordinary in the next.
examples.trans: 十年前算先进的东西，下一个十年就变平常了。

inaccurate.usageZh: 形容词：不准确、有误差。反义 accurate。副词 inaccurately；名词 inaccuracy。常修饰 information, map, translation, figure。

examples.sentence: The old map is inaccurate about the new bridge.
examples.trans: 旧地图把新桥标错了。

examples.sentence: An inaccurate clock made us miss the first song.
examples.trans: 不准的钟让我们错过了第一首歌。

examples.sentence: His inaccurate summary left out the key safety rule.
examples.trans: 他不准确的摘要漏掉了关键安全规则。

examples.sentence: Inaccurate captions on photos can spread faster than corrections.
examples.trans: 照片上不准确的说明，传播得比更正更快。

examples.sentence: The report was not lying, but several figures were inaccurate by a wide margin.
examples.trans: 报告并非撒谎，但有几个数字偏差很大。

examples.sentence: An inaccurate model of demand will quietly bankrupt a careful plan.
examples.trans: 对需求的不准确模型，会悄悄毁掉一份谨慎的计划。

communicate.usageZh: 动词：交流、传达。不及物 communicate with sb；及物 communicate an idea to sb。名词 communication；形容词 communicative。

examples.sentence: We communicate with Grandma on the phone every Sunday.
examples.trans: 我们每周日打电话和奶奶交流。

examples.sentence: The two teams communicate with hand signals in the noisy hall.
examples.trans: 嘈杂的大厅里，两队用手势交流。

examples.sentence: She communicated the change of plan in a short note.
examples.trans: 她用一张短纸条传达了计划的改动。

examples.sentence: Leaders who communicate late force others to invent the missing facts.
examples.trans: 沟通太晚的负责人，会逼别人去编造缺失的事实。

examples.sentence: The app helps hikers communicate even when the mountain road has no signal towers nearby.
examples.trans: 即使山路附近没有信号塔，这款应用也能帮徒步者联络。

examples.sentence: To communicate across disciplines is to translate assumptions, not only terms.
examples.trans: 跨学科交流要翻译的是前提，而不只是术语。

familiar.usageZh: 形容词：熟悉的。sb is familiar with sth；sth is familiar to sb。动词 familiarize；名词 familiarity。反义 unfamiliar。

examples.sentence: This street is familiar because my aunt lives here.
examples.trans: 这条街很熟，因为阿姨住在这儿。

examples.sentence: He is not yet familiar with the new locker codes.
examples.trans: 他还不熟悉新的储物柜密码。

examples.sentence: The melody grew familiar after she heard it three times.
examples.trans: 听了三遍后，这段旋律就熟悉了。

examples.sentence: A familiar argument can still be wrong; comfort is not evidence.
examples.trans: 熟悉的论点仍可能是错的；舒服不是证据。

examples.sentence: She familiarized herself with the tide tables before launching the boat.
examples.trans: 开船前，她先熟悉了潮汐表。

examples.sentence: What feels familiar in a new city is often a copy of home, not the city itself.
examples.trans: 在陌生城市里感到熟悉的，往往是家乡的复制，而不是这座城本身。

properly.usageZh: 副词：正确地、适当地，修饰动词：eat properly, work properly, lock the door properly。形容词 proper。反义 improperly。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands properly before lunch.
examples.trans: 午饭前把手洗干净。

examples.sentence: The lamp will not work properly if the plug is loose.
examples.trans: 插头松了，灯就不能正常工作。

examples.sentence: She packed the glasses properly so none broke on the train.
examples.trans: 她把杯子包好，火车上一个也没碎。

examples.sentence: A tool used improperly can injure faster than it can help.
examples.trans: 工具用得不对，伤人比帮人更快。

examples.sentence: The contract was properly dated, stamped, and filed before noon.
examples.trans: 合同在中午前就正确标注日期、盖章并归档了。

examples.sentence: Until the sensors are calibrated properly, the dashboard will keep telling elegant lies.
examples.trans: 传感器没校准好之前，仪表盘会一直说出精致的谎话。

experience.usageZh: 不可数名词：经验 work/learning experience；可数名词：一次经历 a travel experience。动词 experience 经历。形容词 experienced。

examples.sentence: Camping in the rain was a new experience for me.
examples.trans: 雨中露营对我来说是新经历。

examples.sentence: She has some experience in looking after rabbits.
examples.trans: 她有一点照顾兔子的经验。

examples.sentence: They experienced a sudden blackout during the film.
examples.trans: 看电影时他们经历了突然停电。

examples.sentence: Experience teaches what textbooks only outline.
examples.trans: 经验教会课本只勾勒过的东西。

examples.sentence: An experienced guide changed the route when the river rose.
examples.trans: 河水上涨时，有经验的向导改了路线。

examples.sentence: What we call experience is often a pattern we noticed just in time.
examples.trans: 我们所谓的经验，常常只是及时察觉到的一种模式。

pronunciation.usageZh: 不可数名词：发音方式。improve/practise pronunciation。动词 pronounce；形容词 pronounced（明显的）词义不同。

examples.sentence: Her pronunciation of 'three' is very clear.
examples.trans: 她发 three 这个音很清楚。

examples.sentence: He checks the pronunciation of new names before calling them.
examples.trans: 叫新名字前，他先核对其发音。

examples.sentence: A small change in pronunciation made the joke land.
examples.trans: 发音上的一点变化让笑话奏效了。

examples.sentence: Pronunciation marks attitude as much as it marks sound.
examples.trans: 发音既标声音，也标态度。

examples.sentence: The announcer mispronounced the village name, then corrected it at once.
examples.trans: 播音员把村名读错了，随即立刻纠正。

examples.sentence: Learners chase a native pronunciation that even natives do not share.
examples.trans: 学习者追一种连母语者都不共享的“标准发音”。

phrase.usageZh: 可数名词：短语、词组 a set phrase, useful phrases。动词 phrase 措辞。形容词 phrasal：phrasal verb。

examples.sentence: 'Good morning' is a short phrase we use every day.
examples.trans: “早上好”是我们每天用的短短语。

examples.sentence: Write down any useful phrase you hear in the song.
examples.trans: 把歌里听到的有用短语记下来。

examples.sentence: The coach phrased the advice more kindly the second time.
examples.trans: 教练第二次把建议说得更温和。

examples.sentence: A tired phrase can hide a precise thought.
examples.trans: 陈旧的短语可能藏着精确的想法。

examples.sentence: She crossed out the legal phrase and wrote a sentence a neighbour could follow.
examples.trans: 她划掉法律套话，写成邻居也能看懂的句子。

examples.sentence: How a demand is phrased often decides whether it is heard as a request or a threat.
examples.trans: 要求的措辞，常常决定它被听成请求还是威胁。

support.usageZh: 可作不可数名词：give/need support；也可作动词：support a friend / a team。形容词 supportive。emotional support 情感支持。

examples.sentence: My sister gave me support when I felt shy.
examples.trans: 我害羞时，姐姐给了我支持。

examples.sentence: Wooden poles support the small roof of the stall.
examples.trans: 木杆支撑着摊位的小屋顶。

examples.sentence: Neighbours showed support by bringing hot soup after the flood.
examples.trans: 洪水后邻居送来热汤表示支持。

examples.sentence: Support that arrives without listening can feel like another task.
examples.trans: 不先倾听就给出的支持，可能像又一项任务。

examples.sentence: The bridge was supported by two new beams after the inspection.
examples.trans: 检查后，桥被两根新梁撑住了。

examples.sentence: Public support for the park faded when evening lights stayed broken for months.
examples.trans: 夜灯坏了几个月，公众对公园的支持便淡了。

essential.usageZh: 形容词：必要的、核心的。be essential to/for sth；essential skills/values。名词 essence；副词 essentially。近义 vital, necessary。

examples.sentence: Water is essential on a long walk.
examples.trans: 长途步行时水是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: A torch is essential if we return after dark.
examples.trans: 天黑后回来，手电筒必不可少。

examples.sentence: Sleep is essential to a clear head the next morning.
examples.trans: 睡眠对第二天头脑清醒必不可少。

examples.sentence: Trust is essential to any team that shares unfinished work.
examples.trans: 对分享未完成工作的团队来说，信任是必要的。

examples.sentence: The kit lists only essential tools so the bag stays light.
examples.trans: 工具包只列必需工具，包才能保持轻便。

examples.sentence: What is essential in a crisis is often invisible in ordinary weeks.
examples.trans: 危机中必不可少的东西，在平常的几周里往往看不见。

perception.usageZh: 不可数或可数名词：感知、看法。change/shape/limit perception；public perception。动词 perceive；形容词 perceptive。

examples.sentence: His perception of the city changed after one night market.
examples.trans: 逛过一次夜市后，他对这座城的看法变了。

examples.sentence: From the back row, her perception of the stage was incomplete.
examples.trans: 坐在后排，她对舞台的感知是不完整的。

examples.sentence: Loud colours can change a child's perception of a quiet room.
examples.trans: 鲜艳颜色会改变孩子对安静房间的感觉。

examples.sentence: Public perception often lags behind the data by several years.
examples.trans: 公众看法常常落后数据好几年。

examples.sentence: A perceptive neighbour noticed the uncollected post and knocked.
examples.trans: 敏锐的邻居发现信件没人收，便来敲门。

examples.sentence: Perception is not a photograph; it is a story the brain finishes in a hurry.
examples.trans: 感知不是照片，而是大脑匆忙补完的故事。

master.usageZh: 及物动词：精通 master a language/skill。也可作名词：主人、大师。形容词 masterful。名词 mastery。

examples.sentence: She wants to master the new song this month.
examples.trans: 她想这个月把新歌练熟。

examples.sentence: He mastered the lock after watching Grandpa twice.
examples.trans: 看爷爷开了两次锁，他就学会了。

examples.sentence: It took a year to master the quiet stroke in the pool.
examples.trans: 花了一年才掌握泳池里安静的划水。

examples.sentence: To master a craft is to notice mistakes that beginners cannot yet see.
examples.trans: 精通一门手艺，就是看见初学者还看不见的错误。

examples.sentence: The young chef has not mastered heat control, though her seasoning is brave.
examples.trans: 年轻厨师还没掌握火候，尽管调味很大胆。

examples.sentence: Mastery without curiosity turns into repetition dressed as excellence.
examples.trans: 没有好奇心的精通，会变成伪装成卓越的重复。

access.usageZh: 名词：have/gain/easy access to sth。动词 access a file 访问。形容词 accessible。反义 inaccessible。

examples.sentence: Students have access to the library after school.
examples.trans: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。

examples.sentence: We could not access the upstairs room without the key.
examples.trans: 没有钥匙，我们进不了楼上的房间。

examples.sentence: Wheelchair access was added beside the old stone steps.
examples.trans: 旧石阶旁加了轮椅通道。

examples.sentence: Access to clean water still decides where a village can grow.
examples.trans: 能否用上干净的水，仍决定村庄能在哪里发展。

examples.sentence: Researchers accessed the archive only after signing a quiet agreement.
examples.trans: 研究者签下一份低调协议后，才得以查阅档案。

examples.sentence: When access is sold as a privilege, knowledge starts to look like a gated park.
examples.trans: 当使用权被当成特权出售，知识看起来就像一座上锁的公园。

inconvenience.usageZh: 多作不可数名词：cause/put sb to inconvenience。动词 inconvenience sb 给人添麻烦。形容词 inconvenient。

examples.sentence: The closed lift caused a little inconvenience.
examples.trans: 电梯关闭造成了一点不便。

examples.sentence: Sorry for the inconvenience; the road is being repaired.
examples.trans: 造成不便很抱歉，这条路正在修。

examples.sentence: A delayed ferry inconvenienced families waiting with cold food.
examples.trans: 轮渡延误，让带着冷食等候的家庭很麻烦。

examples.sentence: What looks like a small inconvenience can undo a tightly timed plan.
examples.trans: 看似小小的不便，也能打乱排得很紧的计划。

examples.sentence: They chose an inconvenient meeting hour so both shifts could attend once.
examples.trans: 他们选了一个不便的开会时间，好让两个班次都能来一次。

examples.sentence: Cities often hide inconvenience behind those who cannot reschedule their lives.
examples.trans: 城市常常把不便藏到那些无法改期生活的人身上。

resources.usageZh: 通常用复数：money, materials, staff, online resources。单数 resource。形容词 resourceful 善于想办法。动词 resource 较少用。

examples.sentence: The classroom has many picture-book resources.
examples.trans: 教室里有许多图画书资源。

examples.sentence: We used online resources to check the train times.
examples.trans: 我们用网上资源核对火车时刻。

examples.sentence: The small farm stretched its water resources through a dry August.
examples.trans: 小农场靠有限的水资源撑过了干燥的八月。

examples.sentence: Human resources are not a pool you can drain without consequence.
examples.trans: 人力资源不是可以抽干而不付出代价的池子。

examples.sentence: A resourceful neighbour fixed the pump with spare parts from a bicycle.
examples.trans: 机智的邻居用自行车零件修好了水泵。

examples.sentence: When public resources shrink, private luck starts to look like talent.
examples.trans: 公共资源缩水时，私人运气开始看起来像才能。

afford.usageZh: 及物动词：有足够金钱或时间做某事。can/could/be able to afford sth / to do。否定 can't afford to wait。名词 affordability。

examples.sentence: We cannot afford a taxi tonight, so we will walk.
examples.trans: 今晚打不起车，我们走路。

examples.sentence: Can you afford to buy both tickets and still eat lunch?
examples.trans: 你买得起两张票还吃得起午饭吗？

examples.sentence: They could not afford to miss another practice before the match.
examples.trans: 比赛前他们再错过一次训练就亏不起了。

examples.sentence: A city that cannot afford parks will pay later in crowded rooms.
examples.trans: 建不起公园的城市，日后会在拥挤的房间里还债。

examples.sentence: She afforded herself one slow morning after the long audit.
examples.trans: 漫长审计之后，她允许自己过一个慢早晨。

examples.sentence: What we cannot afford is not always money; sometimes it is another delay.
examples.trans: 我们负担不起的，不一定是钱；有时是再一次拖延。

advantages.usageZh: 可数名词，常用复数 advantages。have/offer an advantage over sb。反义 disadvantage。形容词 advantageous。

examples.sentence: Living near school has many advantages.
examples.trans: 住在学校附近有许多好处。

examples.sentence: One advantage of a bike is that you skip the traffic jam.
examples.trans: 骑自行车的一个优点是能躲开堵车。

examples.sentence: Height gave her an advantage on the volleyball court.
examples.trans: 身高让她在排球场上占优。

examples.sentence: Early data is an advantage only if someone knows how to read it.
examples.trans: 早到的数据只有在有人会读时才是优势。

examples.sentence: The new route is advantageous in winter because it avoids the icy bridge.
examples.trans: 新路线冬天更有利，因为它避开结冰的桥。

examples.sentence: Apparent advantages can hide costs that arrive after the contract is signed.
examples.trans: 表面上的优势可能藏着签约之后才到来的代价。

affordable.usageZh: 形容词：价格合理、负担得起。affordable housing/meals/tickets。由 afford 派生。反义 unaffordable。

examples.sentence: This café has affordable sandwiches for students.
examples.trans: 这家咖啡馆有学生负担得起的三明治。

examples.sentence: They looked for an affordable tent before the camping trip.
examples.trans: 露营前他们找顶价格合适的帐篷。

examples.sentence: The city promised more affordable flats near the new station.
examples.trans: 市政府承诺在新车站附近提供更多可负担公寓。

examples.sentence: Affordable care is not the same as cheap care that cuts safety.
examples.trans: 可负担的护理，不等于为省钱而削减安全的廉价护理。

examples.sentence: An affordable ticket still costs too much if the venue is hours away.
examples.trans: 如果场馆要走好几小时，便宜票也可能太贵。

examples.sentence: Until wages move, calling a district affordable is mostly a slogan.
examples.trans: 工资不动之前，把一个街区称为可负担，多半只是口号。

widespread.usageZh: 形容词：分布广、普遍存在。widespread use/support/damage。副词 widely 相关但不等于 widespread。

examples.sentence: Raincoats are in widespread use on wet mornings.
examples.trans: 潮湿的早晨，雨衣用得很普遍。

examples.sentence: The flu became widespread in the valley last winter.
examples.trans: 去年冬天流感在山谷里蔓延得很广。

examples.sentence: There is widespread support for keeping the night market open.
examples.trans: 普遍支持夜市继续开放。

examples.sentence: Widespread rumour outran the official statement by several hours.
examples.trans: 广泛流传的谣言比官方声明早了好几个小时。

examples.sentence: Damage was widespread along the coast, though the harbour wall held.
examples.trans: 沿岸破坏很广，但港墙守住了。

examples.sentence: A widespread technology can still leave the people who built it unpaid.
examples.trans: 一项普及的技术，仍可能让建造它的人拿不到报酬。

ignored.usageZh: ignore 的过去式/过去分词：被忽视、不予理会。cannot be ignored。名词 ignorance 无知（词义不同）。形容词 ignorant。

examples.sentence: The small warning on the bottle was ignored.
examples.trans: 瓶子上的小警告被忽视了。

examples.sentence: He ignored the noisy street and kept reading.
examples.trans: 他不理街上的吵闹，继续看书。

examples.sentence: Safety rules cannot be ignored just because the hill looks easy.
examples.trans: 不能因为山看起来好走就无视安全规则。

examples.sentence: Emails that are ignored still exist; silence is also an answer.
examples.trans: 被忽略的邮件依然存在；沉默也是一种回答。

examples.sentence: The committee ignored the quieter villages when it drew the new bus map.
examples.trans: 委员会画新公交图时忽略了更安静的村子。

examples.sentence: What is ignored in a budget will return as an emergency, usually at night.
examples.trans: 预算里被忽略的东西，往往会作为紧急事件回来，而且通常在夜里。

continuous.usageZh: 形容词：不间断的 continuous rain/contact/progress。副词 continuously。近义 continual 侧重反复发生。名词 continuity。

examples.sentence: There was continuous rain from breakfast to lunch.
examples.trans: 从早饭到午饭一直在下雨。

examples.sentence: The radio played continuous music during the power cut.
examples.trans: 停电时收音机连续放着音乐。

examples.sentence: Continuous practice made her handwriting smaller and clearer.
examples.trans: 持续练习让她的字更小更清楚。

examples.sentence: Continuous noise in the workshop made short meetings necessary.
examples.trans: 车间里持续的噪声让短会变得必要。

examples.sentence: They kept continuous contact with the boat by radio until midnight.
examples.trans: 他们用无线电与船保持连续联系直到午夜。

examples.sentence: Continuous growth is a story companies tell; nature prefers cycles.
examples.trans: 持续增长是公司讲的故事；自然更喜欢循环。

contact.usageZh: 不可数名词：make/keep/lose contact with。也可作动词 contact sb。contact lenses 隐形眼镜为可数。

examples.sentence: Please keep contact with me during the trip.
examples.trans: 旅行期间请和我保持联系。

examples.sentence: She lost contact with her old neighbour after the move.
examples.trans: 搬家后她和老邻居失去了联系。

examples.sentence: The school contacted parents about the early finish.
examples.trans: 学校就提前放学联系了家长。

examples.sentence: First contact with a new team tells you how they handle a small mistake.
examples.trans: 与新团队的第一次接触，能看出他们如何处理小错误。

examples.sentence: A contactless card let him pay when he had forgotten cash.
examples.trans: 忘带现金时，非接触卡让他付了款。

examples.sentence: In a dense city, contact is constant; solitude has to be arranged.
examples.trans: 在密集城市里，接触是持续的；独处反而需要安排。

progress.usageZh: 不可数名词：make/show progress；progress stands still 停滞。动词 progress /prəˈɡres/ 进展。形容词 progressive。

examples.sentence: Your drawing shows real progress this month.
examples.trans: 你这个月的画有真正的进步。

examples.sentence: The builders made slow progress in the heavy rain.
examples.trans: 大雨里工人进展很慢。

examples.sentence: If we stop asking questions, progress will stand still.
examples.trans: 如果我们不再提问，进步就会停住。

examples.sentence: Progress that ignores who is left behind is only speed.
examples.trans: 忽视被落下者的进步，只是速度。

examples.sentence: The talks progressed after both sides put the maps on one table.
examples.trans: 双方把地图放到同一张桌上后，谈判有了进展。

examples.sentence: What we celebrate as progress may be a cost shifted onto another decade.
examples.trans: 我们当作进步来庆祝的，可能是转嫁到下一个十年的成本。

ability.usageZh: 可数或不可数名词：the ability to do sth；improve/develop ability。形容词 able；反义 inability。复数 abilities。

examples.sentence: She has the ability to fix a loose chair.
examples.trans: 她有修好松动椅子的能力。

examples.sentence: His ability to stay calm helped the lost child.
examples.trans: 他保持冷静的能力帮到了迷路的孩子。

examples.sentence: Practice improved her ability to read maps in poor light.
examples.trans: 练习提高了她在弱光下读地图的能力。

examples.sentence: Ability without opportunity still looks like absence of talent.
examples.trans: 没有机会的能力，看起来仍像没有才华。

examples.sentence: The team was unable to launch until the wind dropped.
examples.trans: 风没减弱前，队伍无法出发。

examples.sentence: An ability measured only by tests will miss the work that happens off the page.
examples.trans: 只靠考试衡量的能力，会漏掉纸页之外发生的工作。

improve.usageZh: 及物或不及物动词：improve a skill / improve on a record。名词 improvement；形容词 improved。

examples.sentence: I want to improve my handwriting this term.
examples.trans: 这学期我想把字写好一些。

examples.sentence: The soup improved after she added a little salt.
examples.trans: 她加了点盐，汤就更好喝了。

examples.sentence: They improved the path so bikes could pass safely.
examples.trans: 他们把小路修好，自行车可以安全通过。

examples.sentence: To improve a system you must first admit where it fails quietly.
examples.trans: 要改进一套系统，得先承认它在哪些地方悄悄失灵。

examples.sentence: An improved timetable cut the wait at the ferry by twenty minutes.
examples.trans: 改进后的时刻表把轮渡等候缩短了二十分钟。

examples.sentence: Improvement that cannot be felt by the people who do the work is mostly a slide in a meeting.
examples.trans: 做这项工作的人感觉不到的改进，多半只是会上的一张幻灯片。

attitude.usageZh: 可数名词：态度 attitude towards/to sth。a positive/negative attitude。动词较少用 attitudinize（做作）。

examples.sentence: Her kind attitude made the new boy less nervous.
examples.trans: 她友善的态度让新来的男孩不那么紧张。

examples.sentence: A careless attitude towards fire is dangerous in dry grass.
examples.trans: 在干草地上对火漫不经心很危险。

examples.sentence: His attitude towards mistakes is simple: fix them and continue.
examples.trans: 他对错误的态度很简单：改掉，继续。

examples.sentence: Attitude is visible in how someone treats the person who cannot help them.
examples.trans: 态度显现在一个人如何对待帮不了自己的人。

examples.sentence: Public attitudes towards night buses shifted after two safe winters.
examples.trans: 两个安全的冬天过后，公众对夜班车的态度变了。

examples.sentence: An attitude dressed as realism can be an excuse for leaving the hard part untouched.
examples.trans: 打扮成现实主义的态度，可能是不去碰困难部分的借口。

learn a new language.usageZh: 动词短语：learn 为及物动词，后接 a new language。也可 learn Spanish / learn sign language。强调从不会到会的过程，比 study 更侧重掌握。

examples.sentence: Lily wants to learn a new language this summer.
examples.trans: 莉莉今年夏天想学一门新语言。

examples.sentence: He began to learn a new language so he could write to his cousin.
examples.trans: 他开始学一门新语言，好写信给表哥。

examples.sentence: After moving, she had to learn a new language for the corner shop.
examples.trans: 搬家后，她得为了街角小店再学一门语言。

examples.sentence: People who learn a new language late still reshape how they hear rhythm.
examples.trans: 很晚才学新语言的人，仍会改变自己听节奏的方式。

examples.sentence: To learn a new language in a noisy household is to steal quiet minutes.
examples.trans: 在吵闹的家里学新语言，就是偷安静的几分钟。

examples.sentence: Learning a new language is less a hobby than a long negotiation with habit.
examples.trans: 学一门新语言与其说是爱好，不如说是和习惯的漫长谈判。

stay keen on.usageZh: 动词短语：stay 为系动词，keen on 后接名词或动名词。表示兴趣不消退。时态可变：stayed keen on, remains keen on。

examples.sentence: Stay keen on drawing and your lines will grow steady.
examples.trans: 对画画保持热情，线条就会稳下来。

examples.sentence: She stayed keen on skating even after two falls.
examples.trans: 摔了两跤后，她仍热爱滑冰。

examples.sentence: If you stay keen on the story, the hard words will start to make sense.
examples.trans: 只要你还对故事有热情，难词就会开始说得通。

examples.sentence: Few teams stay keen on a project once the applause has moved on.
examples.trans: 掌声移走之后，很少有团队还对项目保持热情。

examples.sentence: He stayed keen on night photography though the river path was cold.
examples.trans: 尽管河边小路很冷，他仍热衷夜间摄影。

examples.sentence: To stay keen on a craft after the first prizes is the quieter test.
examples.trans: 得过最初的奖之后仍热衷一门手艺，才是更安静的考验。

stick to it.usageZh: 口语化短语动词：stick to 坚持，it 指正在做的事。也可 stick to the plan。过去式 stuck to it。

examples.sentence: The puzzle is hard, but stick to it.
examples.trans: 拼图很难，但坚持下去。

examples.sentence: He stuck to it and finished the model plane.
examples.trans: 他坚持下来，做完了飞机模型。

examples.sentence: Stick to it for two more weeks and the habit will feel lighter.
examples.trans: 再坚持两周，这个习惯就会轻一些。

examples.sentence: She stuck to it when the archive lights went off at six.
examples.trans: 档案馆六点熄灯，她还是坚持做完。

examples.sentence: Anyone can start a notebook; sticking to it through February is rarer.
examples.trans: 谁都能开始记笔记；能坚持过二月的更少。

examples.sentence: To stick to it while results stay invisible requires a reason that is not applause.
examples.trans: 结果仍看不见时还坚持下去，需要一个不是掌声的理由。

work towards.usageZh: 动词短语：work towards a goal/peace/a certificate，后接名词或动名词。强调过程而非立刻完成。也可 work toward（美式）。

examples.sentence: We work towards a cleaner playground every Friday.
examples.trans: 我们每周五都为更干净的操场努力。

examples.sentence: She is working towards a swimming badge this term.
examples.trans: 这学期她在为游泳徽章努力。

examples.sentence: The village worked towards a shared well for three summers.
examples.trans: 村子为共用的水井努力了三个夏天。

examples.sentence: They are working towards an agreement that both farms can sign.
examples.trans: 他们在努力达成两家农场都能签字的协议。

examples.sentence: Working towards quieter streets meant fewer night deliveries, not more slogans.
examples.trans: 要让街道更安静，意味着减少夜间送货，而不是多喊口号。

examples.sentence: To work towards justice is to accept that some wins will look incomplete.
examples.trans: 为正义努力，就要接受有些胜利看起来并不完整。

talk to yourself.usageZh: 动词短语：自言自语。talk to oneself。在语言学习中指出声练习。也可 talk to yourself in English。

examples.sentence: I talk to myself when I count the stairs.
examples.trans: 我数楼梯时会自言自语。

examples.sentence: She talks to herself in English while washing dishes.
examples.trans: 她洗碗时用英语自言自语。

examples.sentence: Talking to yourself on a bike ride can help you plan the next turn.
examples.trans: 骑车时自言自语，能帮你想好下一个弯。

examples.sentence: He talks to himself not from loneliness but to hear the sentence before he sends it.
examples.trans: 他自言自语不是因为孤独，而是想在发出句子前先听见它。

examples.sentence: Late at night she talked to herself in a whisper so the baby would not wake.
examples.trans: 深夜她低声自言自语，免得吵醒宝宝。

examples.sentence: To talk to yourself in a new language is to build a listener who will not laugh too soon.
examples.trans: 用新语言自言自语，是给自己造一个不会太早笑的听众。

build up.usageZh: 可分开的短语动词：build up confidence/strength/a collection。也可 build sth up。名词 build-up 积聚。

examples.sentence: Slow runs help you build up strong legs.
examples.trans: 慢跑帮你慢慢练出有力的腿。

examples.sentence: She built up a pile of smooth stones by the river.
examples.trans: 她在河边堆起一堆光滑的石头。

examples.sentence: Kind replies built up his confidence to speak in the meeting.
examples.trans: 友善的回应让他慢慢有信心在会上发言。

examples.sentence: Dust will build up behind the fridge if nobody moves it.
examples.trans: 没人挪冰箱的话，灰会在后面积起来。

examples.sentence: They built the emergency fund up over four lean years.
examples.trans: 他们在四个清苦的年头里把应急金慢慢攒起来。

examples.sentence: A build-up of small delays can look like bad luck until you draw the timeline.
examples.trans: 许多小延误积在一起，看起来像倒霉，直到你画出时间线。

have fun with.usageZh: 动词短语：have fun with sth/sb 享受其中。have fun doing 也很常见。fun 在此为不可数名词。

examples.sentence: Have fun with the new crayons.
examples.trans: 好好用新蜡笔玩吧。

examples.sentence: The kids have fun with the cardboard boxes more than the toy.
examples.trans: 孩子们玩纸箱比玩玩具还开心。

examples.sentence: She has fun with word games on the bus home.
examples.trans: 她坐回家的公交时玩文字游戏，很开心。

examples.sentence: You can have fun with a tight budget if the kitchen still has spices.
examples.trans: 预算紧也可以玩得开心，只要厨房里还有香料。

examples.sentence: He had fun with the old camera once he stopped fearing wasted film.
examples.trans: 他不再害怕浪费胶卷后，玩起那台旧相机就开心了。

examples.sentence: Having fun with a difficult tool is often the moment skill actually arrives.
examples.trans: 与一件难用的工具玩得开心时，技能往往才真正到来。

focus on.usageZh: 短语动词：focus on sth/doing。名词 focus；形容词 focused。反义 lose focus。也可 focus sth on。

examples.sentence: Focus on the ball, not the crowd.
examples.trans: 盯着球，别看人群。

examples.sentence: Tonight we will focus on cutting the fruit safely.
examples.trans: 今晚我们专注于安全切水果。

examples.sentence: She focused on the quietest child in the noisy room.
examples.trans: 嘈杂房间里，她把注意放在最安静的孩子身上。

examples.sentence: A hospital that focuses only on speed will miss the slow infections.
examples.trans: 只关注速度的医院，会漏掉缓慢的感染。

examples.sentence: He lost focus when the radio switched to an argumentative show.
examples.trans: 收音机换成争辩节目时，他走神了。

examples.sentence: To focus on what is measurable is tempting; the rest still shapes the outcome.
examples.trans: 专注于可测量的东西很诱人；其余部分仍在塑造结果。

make mistakes.usageZh: 动词短语：make a mistake / make mistakes。可加 in：make mistakes in grammar。过去式 made mistakes。

examples.sentence: Everyone makes mistakes when they learn to ride.
examples.trans: 学骑车时人人都会犯错。

examples.sentence: I made a mistake with the sugar and the cake was too sweet.
examples.trans: 我把糖放错了，蛋糕太甜。

examples.sentence: She makes fewer mistakes now that she reads the label twice.
examples.trans: 她现在少犯错了，因为标签会读两遍。

examples.sentence: Teams that hide mistakes only postpone the larger one.
examples.trans: 隐瞒错误的团队，只是把更大的错误往后推。

examples.sentence: He made a mistake in the address, so the parcel travelled an extra day.
examples.trans: 他写错地址，包裹多走了一天。

examples.sentence: The useful question is not whether we make mistakes, but how quickly we name them.
examples.trans: 有用的问题不是我们会不会犯错，而是我们多快把错误说出来。

get your meaning.usageZh: 口语短语：听懂你要表达的意思。get sb's meaning。也可 get the meaning of a joke。get 此处为“理解”。

examples.sentence: Speak slowly so I can get your meaning.
examples.trans: 说慢一点，好让我明白你的意思。

examples.sentence: She used her hands until we got her meaning.
examples.trans: 她比划着手，直到我们明白她的意思。

examples.sentence: Even with a wrong word, the waiter got your meaning and brought soup.
examples.trans: 就算用词错了，服务员还是明白你的意思，把汤端来了。

examples.sentence: Listeners get your meaning faster when you start with the point, not the history.
examples.trans: 先说重点而不是历史，听的人更快明白你的意思。

examples.sentence: The translator paused, then found a word that let the room get his meaning.
examples.trans: 译者停了一下，然后找到一个让全场明白他意思的词。

examples.sentence: If people only get your meaning when you shout, the problem may be the channel, not the idea.
examples.trans: 如果只有你喊他们才明白，问题可能在通道，不在想法。

communicate with.usageZh: 动词短语：communicate with sb/sth。后接人或群体。也可 communicate with a device。名词 communication with。

examples.sentence: I communicate with my cousin by voice messages.
examples.trans: 我和表姐用语音消息交流。

examples.sentence: The sailors communicate with lights when the radio fails.
examples.trans: 无线电失灵时，水手用灯光联络。

examples.sentence: She finds it easier to communicate with children than with cameras.
examples.trans: 她觉得和孩子交流比对着镜头容易。

examples.sentence: Offices that communicate with silence still send a message.
examples.trans: 用沉默交流的办公室，仍然在发信息。

examples.sentence: The ranger communicated with the lost hikers by whistle until dawn.
examples.trans: 护林员用口哨和迷路的徒步者联络到天亮。

examples.sentence: To communicate with another field you must risk sounding naive for a week.
examples.trans: 要与另一领域交流，你得冒险有一周听起来很天真。

not only... but also....usageZh: 关联连词：连接两个对等成分。Not only A but also B。A、B 词性要平行。位于句首时 not only 后可部分倒装。

examples.sentence: She not only sings but also plays the drums.
examples.trans: 她不仅唱歌，还打鼓。

examples.sentence: The stall sells not only fruit but also hot tea.
examples.trans: 摊位不仅卖水果，还卖热茶。

examples.sentence: He not only repaired the bike but also taught me the trick.
examples.trans: 他不仅修了车，还把窍门教给了我。

examples.sentence: The flood damaged not only shops but also the records in the basement.
examples.trans: 洪水不仅冲了店铺，还毁了地下室的档案。

examples.sentence: Not only did the lab publish the data, but it also posted the raw files.
examples.trans: 实验室不仅发表了数据，还公布了原始文件。

examples.sentence: A good public space serves not only leisure but also the unplanned conversations that hold a street together.
examples.trans: 好的公共空间不仅服务休闲，还服务把一条街黏在一起的那些不期而遇的谈话。

The more..., the more....usageZh: 固定比较结构：The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...，表示按比例变化。两句都要有 the。可与 -er 或 more/less 连用。

examples.sentence: The more you stir, the thicker the soup becomes.
examples.trans: 你搅得越多，汤就越稠。

examples.sentence: The more we walked, the quieter the road became.
examples.trans: 我们走得越远，路就越安静。

examples.sentence: The more she practised the kick, the cleaner it looked.
examples.trans: 她练踢得越多，动作看起来越干净。

examples.sentence: The more data you dump on a tired team, the less they can use.
examples.trans: 你往疲惫团队上堆的数据越多，他们能用的就越少。

examples.sentence: The more carefully he labelled the shelves, the faster the night shift found parts.
examples.trans: 他给架子贴标签越仔细，夜班找到零件就越快。

examples.sentence: The more a city treats shade as decoration, the more its summers punish people on foot.
examples.trans: 一座城市越把树荫当装饰，夏天就越惩罚走路的人。

mother tongue.usageZh: 名词短语：母语、第一语言。也作 first language, native language。复数 mother tongues。

examples.sentence: My mother tongue is the language I dreamed in as a child.
examples.trans: 我的母语是我小时候做梦用的语言。

examples.sentence: He writes poems in his mother tongue and emails in English.
examples.trans: 他用母语写诗，用英语写邮件。

examples.sentence: Children can keep two mother tongues if both are used at dinner.
examples.trans: 如果餐桌上两种语言都用，孩子可以保住两种母语。

examples.sentence: Losing a mother tongue is often quieter than losing a house.
examples.trans: 失去母语，往往比失去房子更安静。

examples.sentence: The radio still broadcasts weather in the village's mother tongue at dawn.
examples.trans: 电台仍在黎明用村里的母语播报天气。

examples.sentence: A mother tongue can hold jokes that no later language quite inherits.
examples.trans: 母语能装下后来的语言继承不全的笑话。

It goes without saying.usageZh: 固定插入语：不言而喻。常接 that 从句。语气正式偏书面，也可口语。近义 needless to say。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that we lock the door at night.
examples.trans: 夜里要锁门，这不言而喻。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that wet wood will not light easily.
examples.trans: 湿木头不容易点着，这不用说。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that a tired driver should not start a long trip.
examples.trans: 疲惫的司机不该开长途，这是明摆着的。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that unpaid internships exclude those who must earn.
examples.trans: 无薪实习把必须挣钱的人排除在外，这不必多说。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that the lab stays sealed until the alarm is green.
examples.trans: 警报变绿之前实验室保持封闭，这理所当然。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that a treaty without inspectors is mostly paper.
examples.trans: 没有核查员的条约多半是纸，这无需强调。

face to face.usageZh: 副词短语：面对面。也可作定语 a face-to-face meeting（需连字符）。常与 meet, talk, learn 连用。

examples.sentence: I talked to the teacher face to face after school.
examples.trans: 放学后我和老师当面谈了。

examples.sentence: They finally met face to face at the station.
examples.trans: 他们终于在车站面对面见了面。

examples.sentence: A face-to-face apology landed better than a long message.
examples.trans: 当面道歉比一长段消息更到位。

examples.sentence: Some deals still require sitting face to face across a scratched table.
examples.trans: 有些交易仍需要隔着一张有刮痕的桌子面对面坐着。

examples.sentence: She preferred to explain the bill face to face so nothing hid in small print.
examples.trans: 她宁愿当面解释账单，免得小字里藏东西。

examples.sentence: Face-to-face work does not guarantee honesty; it only removes one kind of delay.
examples.trans: 面对面并不能保证诚实，只是去掉一种拖延。

afford that.usageZh: 动词短语：afford 后接 that 指代前文的费用或安排。常用于否定：can't afford that。也可 afford to do that。

examples.sentence: A taxi would be nice, but we cannot afford that tonight.
examples.trans: 打车是好，但今晚我们负担不起。

examples.sentence: Private lessons help, if a family can afford that.
examples.trans: 如果家里负担得起，私教课是有帮助的。

examples.sentence: A second fridge would save trips, yet they could not afford that bill.
examples.trans: 第二台冰箱能少跑腿，可那笔账单他们付不起。

examples.sentence: The city wants night buses; the question is whether it can afford that every winter.
examples.trans: 城市想要夜班车；问题是每个冬天是否都负担得起。

examples.sentence: She could afford that risk once, but not twice in the same season.
examples.trans: 那种风险她能承担一次，但不能在同一季承担两次。

examples.sentence: When a society cannot afford that kind of care, it still pays, only later and in harsher rooms.
examples.trans: 一个社会若负担不起那种照料，它仍会付钱，只是更晚、在更苛刻的房间里。

through the Internet.usageZh: 介词短语：通过互联网，表示途径。也可 on the Internet / via the Internet。Internet 常大写。

examples.sentence: Grandpa learned chess through the Internet.
examples.trans: 爷爷通过互联网学会了下棋。

examples.sentence: We ordered the spare part through the Internet and it arrived Friday.
examples.trans: 我们通过互联网订了零件，周五就到了。

examples.sentence: She found old maps through the Internet instead of travelling to the archive.
examples.trans: 她通过互联网找到旧地图，而不必跑去档案馆。

examples.sentence: Rumours move through the Internet faster than corrections can lace their shoes.
examples.trans: 谣言在网上走得比更正系鞋带还快。

examples.sentence: The clinic booked follow-up visits through the Internet to spare a long queue.
examples.trans: 诊所通过互联网预约复诊，免得排长队。

examples.sentence: Knowledge that travels only through the Internet still depends on who owns the cable.
examples.trans: 只通过互联网旅行的知识，仍取决于谁拥有那根缆线。

distance education.usageZh: 名词短语：远程教育。近义 remote learning, online education。作主语或宾语。

examples.sentence: Distance education helped her study while living on the farm.
examples.trans: 远程教育让她住在农场也能学习。

examples.sentence: The college offered distance education for nurses on night shifts.
examples.trans: 学院为上夜班的护士提供远程教育。

examples.sentence: Distance education is not easier; it only moves the classroom into a smaller room.
examples.trans: 远程教育并不更容易，只是把教室搬进更小的房间。

examples.sentence: Good distance education still needs a person who answers on Thursdays.
examples.trans: 好的远程教育仍然需要一个周四会回复的人。

examples.sentence: During the storms, distance education kept the timetable from collapsing.
examples.trans: 暴风雨期间，远程教育让课表没有垮掉。

examples.sentence: Distance education widens access and, if badly funded, also widens the gap.
examples.trans: 远程教育扩大了入口；若经费不足，也会扩大差距。

stand still.usageZh: 动词短语：静止不动；比喻停滞不前。progress will not stand still。进行时 standing still。

examples.sentence: Please stand still while I take the photo.
examples.trans: 我拍照时请站着别动。

examples.sentence: The queue stood still for ten minutes in the rain.
examples.trans: 队伍在雨里停了十分钟。

examples.sentence: If nobody asks a new question, the project will stand still.
examples.trans: 如果没人问新问题，项目就会停住。

examples.sentence: Wages cannot stand still while rents climb every spring.
examples.trans: 租金每年春天都在涨，工资不能原地不动。

examples.sentence: The investigation stood still until the missing notebook returned.
examples.trans: 丢失的笔记本回来之前，调查一直停着。

examples.sentence: History does not stand still; we only stop looking, then call the pause peace.
examples.trans: 历史不会停住；我们只是不再看，然后把停顿称作和平。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'would' for Polite Assumption / 情态动词'would'表示礼貌推测
grammar.title: 情态动词 would：委婉推测、礼貌看法，兼辨 will / must / might / would have
grammar.titleEn: Would for polite assumption, plus will, must, might, and would have
grammar.usage: would 可表示委婉推测、礼貌看法或假想结果，语气比 will 弱。常与 probably, possibly 连用。肯定：You would probably agree... 否定：wouldn't。疑问：Would you...？对比：will 较确定；must 表较有把握的推测；might/could 把握更低；used to / would 还可表过去习惯。初中抓：would 后接动词原形，无人称变化。高中抓：would have done 对过去的推测；I would imagine / I would say 为礼貌表态。
forms: 主语 + would / wouldn't + 动词原形（委婉推测或看法）
Would + 主语 + 动词原形？（礼貌询问）
would probably / possibly + 动词原形
must / might / could + 动词原形（把握度对比）
would have + 过去分词（对过去的推测或未实现结果）
If + 过去时, 主语 + would + 动词原形（第二类条件）
notes: would 后不加 to，也不加 -s：He would agree，不是 He would to agree。
表示现在推测时，must 比 would 更有把握；might 更不确定。
对过去的礼貌推测用 would have done，不是 would did。
Would you mind + doing 是请求，不是推测。
表过去习惯的 would 不能与状态动词连用：不说 would be a teacher every day。

examples.en: You would probably like this warm soup.
examples.cn: 你大概会喜欢这碗热汤。

examples.en: Most people would agree that the bridge needs lights.
examples.cn: 多数人会同意这座桥需要灯。

examples.en: A tired driver would not start a mountain road at midnight.
examples.cn: 疲惫的司机会在午夜开山路吗？不会。

examples.en: I would imagine the archive closes before dusk.
examples.cn: 我猜想档案馆黄昏前就关门。

examples.en: She would have called if the ferry had been cancelled.
examples.cn: 要是轮渡取消了，她本会打电话。

examples.en: One would have thought the contract mentioned flood risk.
examples.cn: 按理说合同里该提到洪水风险。

exercises.q: Most kids ____ probably like a shorter queue.
exercises.explain: would 后接动词原形，表示委婉推测。

exercises.q: ____ you like some water?
exercises.explain: Would you like... 是礼貌询问。

exercises.q: He ____ agree that the park is too dark.
exercises.explain: probably 常放在 would 之后。

exercises.q: 选择正确的句子。
exercises.explain: would 无人称变化，后接原形。

exercises.q: We ____ stay out so late on a school night.
You would probably ____ (like) this song.
____ you mind waiting two minutes?
exercises.explain: 礼貌请求用 Would you mind。

exercises.q: They wouldn't ____ (walk) home in the storm.
句子 “She would probably come.” 是正确的。
句子 “He woulds like tea.” 是正确的。
用 would 改写：I think they like the quiet street. → They ____ the quiet street.
exercises.explain: 用 would (probably) like 表示委婉看法。

exercises.q: 把 will 改得更委婉：You will agree. → You ____ agree.
exercises.explain: will 改 would 语气更软。

exercises.q: 改成否定：She would wait. → She ____ wait.
改错：He would to carry the bag.
改错：Woulds you open the window?
exercises.explain: 疑问句用 Would + 主语。

exercises.q: A stranger ____ probably knock before entering.
exercises.explain: 对一般情况的礼貌推测用 would。

exercises.q: They ____ stay on the ice; it looks thin.
____ most parents agree that sleep matters?
exercises.explain: Would + 主语 构成疑问。

exercises.q: Which is the softest guess?
exercises.explain: might 把握最低，语气最软。

exercises.q: I ____ say the shop closes at eight.
exercises.explain: I would say 是礼貌表态。

exercises.q: People would probably ____ (choose) the shorter path.
He wouldn't ____ (lend) his bike to a stranger.
Would you ____ (mind) holding the door?
exercises.explain: Would you mind + doing/原形 mind。

exercises.q: “Must” 比 “might” 的推测更有把握。
“Would you like tea?” 是在推测别人正在喝茶。
exercises.explain: 这是礼貌邀请，不是推测。

exercises.q: 用 would probably 改写：I think Tom likes rain. → Tom ____ rain.
改成疑问：You would wait. → ____ you wait?
用 wouldn't 改写：I don't think she agrees. → She ____.
改错：She would agrees with you.
改错：Would you mind to wait?
Most travellers ____ rather take the earlier train.
If the river rose, the village ____ move the animals first.
exercises.explain: 第二类条件主句用 would。

exercises.q: I ____ have thought the museum opened on Mondays.
exercises.explain: would have thought 是对认知的礼貌修正。

exercises.q: Which sentence shows past speculation?
exercises.explain: would have done 指向过去。

exercises.q: You ____ be tired after that climb — look at your knees.
exercises.explain: 有明显证据时用 must 推测。

exercises.q: If I had a torch, I ____ (walk) across the yard.
exercises.explain: 假想现在/将来用 would + 原形。

exercises.q: They would rather ____ (eat) at home tonight.
She ____ have missed the bus; her bag is still here.
“Would rather” 后面接动词原形。
“He would has finished” 是正确的。
用 would rather 改写：She prefers tea to coffee. → She ____ tea than coffee.
exercises.answer: would rather drink / would rather have

exercises.q: 改成对过去的推测：Perhaps they left. → They ____ left.
If I were you, I ____ (not wait).
改错：He would rather to stay.
改错：If it rained, we will cancel.
exercises.answer: If it rained, we would cancel.

exercises.q: One ____ have expected the contract to mention flood risk.
exercises.explain: One would have expected 是书面礼貌推测。

exercises.q: The lights are on; they ____ still be in the lab.
I ____ imagine the archive closes before dusk.
exercises.explain: I would imagine 委婉表态。

exercises.q: Which is a counterfactual about the past?
options: She would have written if she had known.
exercises.answer: She would have written if she had known.

exercises.q: They ____ possibly agree without seeing the numbers.
exercises.explain: wouldn't possibly 表示几乎不可能同意。

exercises.q: The ferry is gone; they ____ have taken an earlier one.
I would say the delay ____ (be) avoidable.
exercises.explain: I would say 后接完整从句。

exercises.q: Had we known, we ____ have waited.
“Would have done” 可以表示未实现的过去结果。
高中书面语里不该使用 “I would say”。
用 would have 改写：They didn't call because they didn't know. → They ____ if they had known.
把 must 改得更不确定：She must be the editor. → She ____ be the editor.
改写：It is likely that he disagrees. → He ____ disagree.
改错：She would has finished earlier.
改错：I would to imagine they left.
A cautious board ____ be reluctant to sign before the audit.
exercises.explain: 对机构态度的礼貌推测。

exercises.q: Given the wet prints, someone ____ have entered after midnight.
exercises.explain: 物证支持对过去的 must have。

exercises.q: ____ you have thought the clause covered night deliveries?
exercises.explain: Would you have thought 质疑预期。

exercises.q: Which modal best softens disagreement?
They ____ possibly have stored the films without a dry box.
The budget ____ have stretched to a second nurse.
I would contend that silence ____ (count) as an answer.
Were the river to rise, the sheds ____ flood.
“Would” 在学术讨论里常用来降低断言的锋芒。
“Must have done” 与 “should have done” 意思完全相同。
exercises.explain: must have 是推测，should have 常是责备或预期。

exercises.q: 改写得更委婉：The plan will fail. → The plan ____ fail.
用 would have 完成：If the sensors had been calibrated, the dashboard ____ lied.
把 used to 改成 would（表过去习惯）：He used to walk the night shift. → He ____ the night shift.
改错：One would thought the clause was clearer.
exercises.answer: One would have thought the clause was clearer.
exercises.explain: 对过去预期用 would have thought。

exercises.q: 改错：They must have been leave already.
exercises.answer: They must have left already. / They must have been leaving already.

exercises.q: A reader ____ be forgiven for missing a footnote buried in the appendix.
exercises.explain: A reader would be forgiven 是书面套语。

exercises.q: The figures ____ have been rounded, which would explain the neat totals.
exercises.explain: 对过去原因的低把握推测。

exercises.q: I ____ hesitate to call this a coincidence.
exercises.explain: I would hesitate 礼貌保留。

exercises.q: Which option marks a past counterfactual?
options: Had the cable failed, the city would have gone dark.
exercises.answer: Had the cable failed, the city would have gone dark.

exercises.q: Such delays ____ not have occurred had inspectors arrived on Monday.
One would have thought the treaty ____ (mention) inspectors.
The lab ____ conceivably have published without the raw files, but it chose not to.
Little ____ they have known that the map was already obsolete.
学术英语里 “would appear to” 可以替代更武断的 “is”。
“Should have done” 永远只表示对过去的事实推测。
exercises.explain: 它更常表示责备或本该。

exercises.q: 改写：It seems the clause is incomplete. → The clause ____ incomplete.
exercises.answer: would appear to be / would seem

exercises.q: 用 would have 改写：They signed because they did not see the flood map. → They ____ if they had seen the flood map.
exercises.answer: would not have signed / wouldn't have signed

exercises.q: 把断言软化：This proves the model is wrong. → This ____ the model is wrong.
改错：The board would has been reluctant to sign.
exercises.answer: The board would have been reluctant to sign.

exercises.q: 改错：Would appear the delay was avoidable.
exercises.answer: The delay would appear to have been avoidable. / It would appear that the delay was avoidable.
exercises.explain: 需要完整主语或 it 句式。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语，兼辨 It is + adj. + to do 与动名词复合结构
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as subject vs infinitive and possessive gerund
grammar.usage: 动名词（动词 -ing）可作主语，把一个活动当成谈论对象：Learning a language takes time。谓语用单数。也可用 It is + adj. + to do 作形式主语改写。否定：Not knowing the code delayed us。初中抓：-ing 作主语 + 单数动词。高中抓：动名词复合结构 Tom's arriving / him arriving；与不定式作主语的语体差异。
forms: 动名词（短语） + 单数谓语
It is + adj. + to do（形式主语，不定式）
Not + 动名词 + 谓语
所有格/宾格 + 动名词（复合结构）
There is no + 动名词（不可能……）
notes: 动名词主语视为单数：Swimming is... 不是 are。
不定式作主语更偏具体、一次性；动名词更偏习惯、抽象。
介词后只能用动名词：before leaving，不是 before to leave。
复合结构正式语用所有格：I insist on his staying。
无生命主语也可用：Reading maps at night requires a torch。

examples.en: Swimming in the lake is fun.
examples.cn: 在湖里游泳很有趣。

examples.en: Waiting for the bus in rain is unpleasant.
examples.cn: 雨中等公交不舒服。

examples.en: Knowing a language helps you ask for directions.
examples.cn: 懂一门语言能帮你问路。

examples.en: Ignoring small leaks leads to expensive repairs.
examples.cn: 忽视小渗漏会导致昂贵维修。

examples.en: His arriving late delayed the night shift.
examples.cn: 他迟到耽误了夜班。

examples.en: There is no denying that shade changes how a street is used.

exercises.q: ____ is good for you.
Reading ____ a quiet room.

____ in line made us hungry.

Collecting stamps ____ patience.
____ the door unlocked is unsafe.

Not ____ the map delayed us.
____ (practice) every day improves her kick.

Wearing a helmet ____ (protect) you.

介词 after 后面接 to do。
用动名词改写：It is fun to cook. → ____ is fun.

exercises.q: It's no use ____ over spilled paint.

It's worth ____ (check) the tide before you sail.
Not ____ (wear) gloves made the job slower.
“It's no use to cry” 比 “It's no use crying” 更标准。

用动名词改写：To master heat takes years. → ____ heat takes years.
改写：It is dangerous to swim here. → ____ here is dangerous.
改错：Knowing a language help you travel.
exercises.answer: Knowing a language helps you travel.

exercises.q: 改错：It's no use to wait any longer.
exercises.answer: It's no use waiting any longer.

exercises.q: ____ assumptions across fields is harder than translating terms.
I insist on ____ staying until the numbers match.

exercises.q: The committee objected to ____ the quiet villages.
____ (treat) shade as decoration punishes people on foot.
We look forward to ____ (see) the inspectors.
It's no good ____ (hide) the delay.
“look forward to” 的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
动名词主语后面的谓语要用复数，因为它表示活动。
用所有格改写：I dislike him arriving late. → I dislike ____ arriving late.

不定式作主语永远比动名词更正式，所以学术写作只用不定式。

exercises.q: 用 for sb to do 改写：Inspectors' arriving on Monday is essential. → It is essential ____ on Monday.
用动名词改写：If we hide the delay, we lose trust. → ____ the delay loses trust.
改写：Nobody could stretch the budget. → There was no ____ the budget.
改错：They objected to change the route.
exercises.answer: They objected to changing the route.

exercises.q: 改错：Offering internships unpaid exclude many.
____ knowledge as a gated park follows from selling access as privilege.
There is no ____ that a treaty without inspectors is mostly paper.
The difficulty lies in ____ assumptions, not merely terms.
____ the raw files would have cost little and bought trust.
I remember ____ the sensors before the launch.

“There is no + gerund” 表示没有做该动作的人。
exercises.explain: 表示不可能/无法否认等。

用动名词改写：If we sell access as privilege, knowledge looks gated. → ____ access as privilege makes knowledge look gated.

grammar.key: First Conditional (if + present simple, future simple/imperative) / 第一类条件句 (if + 一般现在时，一般将来时/祈使句)
grammar.title: 第一类条件句：If + 现在，主句 will / be going to / 情态 / 祈使，兼 unless 与 should 倒装
grammar.titleEn: First conditional with unless, provided that, and should-inversion
grammar.usage: 第一类条件句谈真实可能的将来：If + 一般现在时, 主句 will / be going to / 情态 / 祈使。肯定：If you stay keen, you will improve. 否定：If you don't practise, it isn't going to happen。If 从句不用 will。unless = if ... not。as long as / provided that 也可引导真实条件。初中：时态搭配。高中：should you need（倒装）、祈使+and/or。
forms: If + 现在时, 主语 + will / be going to + 原形
If + 现在时, 祈使句（If you see her, tell her.）
Unless + 现在时, 主句（= if ... not）
If + 现在时, 情态 can/may/must/should
祈使句 + and / or + 将来结果
Should + 主语 + 原形, 主句 will（书面倒装）
notes: If 从句用现在时表将来，避免 if it will rain。
unless 本身含否定，不再加 don't：unless you hurry，不是 unless you don't hurry（除非有意双重否定）。
be going to 强调基于现状的后果。
主句可以是祈使：If the oil smokes, turn the heat down.
provided that / as long as 强调“唯一需要满足的条件”。

exercises.q: If it ____, we will stay inside.
If you run, you ____ catch the bus.
____ you are late, call me.
选择正确句子。
options: If she is free, she will come.
If she will be free, she comes.
If she free, she will come.
If she is free, she coming.
exercises.answer: If she is free, she will come.

exercises.q: If the soup is hot, ____ it slowly.
If Tom ____ (finish) early, he will help us.
If you don't hurry, you ____ miss the start.
If the light is red, ____ (stop).
If 从句里要用 will 表示将来。
“If you see him, tell him.” 是正确的。
用 if 连接：It rains. We stay inside. → If it rains, we ____ inside.
改成否定条件：If you hurry, you will catch it. → If you ____ hurry, you will miss it.
改成祈使主句：If the milk boils, you will turn it down. → If the milk boils, ____ it down.
改错：If it will rain, we stay.
exercises.answer: If it rains, we will stay.

exercises.q: 改错：If she have time, she will come.
exercises.answer: If she has time, she will come.

exercises.q: Unless you ____ the gate, the goats will leave.
If he doesn't practise, it ____ going to happen.
Take a map ____ you will get lost.
If the ice looks thin, you ____ stay off it.
____ you finish, we can leave.
Unless it ____ (stop) raining, we will wait.
Bring a coat ____ you will feel cold.
If they are hungry, they ____ (can / eat) first.
unless 相当于 if ... not。
“Unless you don't lock it” 是最自然的说法。
exercises.explain: 双重否定别扭，用 If you don't lock 或 Unless you lock。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If you don't water it, it will die. → Unless you ____ it, it will die.
用 and 连接：Hurry up. You will catch it. → Hurry up ____ you will catch it.
If she ____ (not be) careful, she will drop it.
改错：Unless you will hurry, you miss it.
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss it.

exercises.q: 改错：If you will see her, tell her.
exercises.answer: If you see her, tell her.

exercises.q: As long as the radio ____, we can ask for a boat.
If the river rises tonight, the sheds ____ flood.
Provided that you ____ a torch, the path is safe.
Should you need help, you ____ ring the bell.
If you can't stay keen, it is never ____ happen.
If the oil smokes, ____ the heat down.
You will not improve unless you ____ (stay) keen.
Should the lights fail, we ____ use the stairs.
第一类条件可以在主句用 be going to。
provided that 引导的从句要用 will。
用 as long as 改写：If you have internet, there are resources. → As long as you ____ internet, there are resources.
用 unless 改写：If you don't stay keen, it will not happen. → Unless you ____ keen, it will not happen.
Should 倒装：If you need water, call us. → Should you ____ water, call us.
改错：If you will not stay keen, it never happens.
exercises.answer: If you don't stay keen, it is never going to happen. / If you don't stay keen, it will never happen.

exercises.q: 改错：Provided that you will bring a torch, we go.
exercises.answer: Provided that you bring a torch, we will go.

exercises.q: If the sensors are not calibrated, the dashboard ____ elegant lies.
Unless inspectors ____ on Monday, the clause is paper.
Should the cable fail, the city ____ go dark.
Give them the raw files ____ trust will follow.
If a family cannot afford private lessons, distance education ____ still help.
If wages freeze, rents ____ still climb.
The plan works provided that both farms ____ (sign).
Fail to name the delay ____ you will lose the room.
exercises.explain: 祈使含义 + and。实际是祈使句 Fail...

exercises.q: Should + 主语 + 原形 可以替代 if 真实条件，语气更书面。
第一类条件主句不能使用 can 或 may。
用 unless 改写：If the board does not see the numbers, it will not sign. → Unless the board ____ the numbers, it will not sign.
倒装：If you need the archive, write ahead. → Should you ____ the archive, write ahead.
用 going to 强调后果：If you hide the leak, it ____ get worse.
改错：If the river will rise, the sheds flood.
exercises.answer: If the river rises, the sheds will flood.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless they will arrive, wait.
If access is sold as privilege, knowledge ____ like a gated park.
The talks will stall unless both maps ____ on one table.
Should night deliveries continue, the street ____ not sleep.
Calibrate the sensors ____ the dashboard will stop lying.
If the intern answers without checking, the client ____ still quote the number.
If shade is treated as decoration, summers ____ punish walkers.
You may publish provided that the raw files ____ (be) posted.
Ignore the quieter villages ____ the map will lie.
provided that 与 as long as 都可以引导充分条件。
真实条件的倒装必须用 Had + 过去分词。
exercises.explain: 那是对过去的虚拟；真实将来用 Should + 原形。

exercises.q: 用 should 倒装：If the audit finds gaps, pause. → Should the audit ____ gaps, pause.
用 unless 改写：If we do not post raw files, trust will thin. → Unless we ____ raw files, trust will thin.
祈使 + or：Name the delay. You will lose the room. → Name the delay ____ you will lose the room.
改错：If inspectors will arrive, the treaty lives.
exercises.answer: If inspectors arrive, the treaty will live. / If inspectors arrive, the treaty lives as a general truth.

exercises.q: 改错：Should the cable failed, the city goes dark.
exercises.answer: Should the cable fail, the city will go dark.

exercises.q: If a society cannot fund that care, it ____ pay later in harsher rooms.
The model will bankrupt the plan unless demand ____ recalibrated.
Should incentives and enforcement fail to move together, campaigns ____.
Publish the files ____ accusations of elegance-without-evidence will fade.
If the footnote stays buried, a reader ____ be forgiven for missing it.
If we mistake delay for peace, the next decade ____ collect the bill.
The clause holds provided that inspectors ____ (have) real access.
Fail to translate assumptions ____ you will only swap terms.
第一类条件可以描述制度性的真实后果，不必谈个人日程。
exercises.explain: 语法管的是可能性，不是话题。

exercises.q: Unless 从句在书面语里必须倒装。
倒装：If the treaty lacks inspectors, it remains paper. → Should the treaty ____ inspectors, it will remain paper.
unless 被动：If the sensors are not calibrated, the dashboard lies. → Unless the sensors ____, the dashboard will lie.
用 going to 强调已有迹象：The river is already high; if it rains, the sheds ____ flood.
改错：If access will be sold as privilege, knowledge looks gated.
exercises.answer: If access is sold as privilege, knowledge will look gated.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless demand will be recalibrated, the model bankrupts the plan.
exercises.answer: Unless demand is recalibrated, the model will bankrupt the plan.

grammar.key: Comparative Structure 'the more..., the more...' / 比较结构 'the more..., the more...'
grammar.title: 关联比较 the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...，兼 less/fewer 与省略式
grammar.titleEn: The more..., the more... (less/fewer and elliptical forms)
grammar.usage: 关联比较：The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...，两个变化按比例发生。可用 -er 或 more/less。可省略：The sooner, the better。对比 more and more（单一趋势）没有两个 the。初中：两个 the + 比较级。高中：the more + 名词、the less/fewer、省略谓语。
forms: The + 比较级 + S + V, the + 比较级 + S + V
The more / less + adj./n. ..., the more / less ...
The sooner / earlier ..., the better ...
省略式：The sooner, the better.
The more + 不可数名词 / The more + 复数 / The fewer + 复数
notes: 两个分句都要有 the，漏 the 是常见错。
必须用比较级，不能用最高级。
the fewer 只接可数复数；the less 接不可数或形容词。
语序固定，一般不把两句对调成非 the 结构还叫同一句型。
时态多为现在或 will，也可过去：The more I thought, the angrier I became.

examples.en: The more you stir, the thicker the soup becomes.

examples.en: The faster she runs, the sooner she gets home.

examples.en: The more you listen, the more familiar it becomes.

examples.en: The earlier the inspectors arrive, the cleaner the files stay.
examples.cn: 检查员到得越早，档案越干净。

examples.en: The more a city treats shade as decoration, the harsher its summers feel.
examples.cn: 越把树荫当装饰，夏天越难受。

exercises.q: The ____ you run, the sooner you arrive.
The more you read, ____ more you know.
The ____ the tea, the better it tastes to him.
选择正确句子。
options: The more you practise, the better you play.
More you practise, better you play.
The most you practise, the better you play.
The more you practise, better you play.
exercises.answer: The more you practise, the better you play.

exercises.q: The more she smiles, the ____ we feel.
The more you stir, ____ thicker the soup becomes.
The ____ (early) we leave, the better.
The more he eats, the ____ (sleepy) he gets.
两个 the 都可以省略。
exercises.explain: 完整结构需要两个 the。

exercises.q: “The sooner, the better.” 是正确的省略。
改写：If you read more, you know more. → The more you read, ____ you know.
改写：If she runs faster, she arrives sooner. → The faster she runs, the ____ she arrives.
补全：The more you listen, ____ familiar it becomes.
改错：The more he practises, better he plays.
exercises.answer: The more he practises, the better he plays.

exercises.q: 改错：The most you wait, the angry you get.
exercises.answer: The more you wait, the angrier you get.

exercises.q: The more languages she learns, the ____ she understands songs.
The less noise we make, the ____ the baby sleeps.
The ____ the bag, the harder the walk.
The more carefully you pack, the ____ glasses break.
____ sooner we finish, the sooner we rest.
The more you listen to it, the more ____ (familiar) it becomes.
The ____ (easy) the path, the faster we walk.
The fewer bags we take, the ____ we move.
the fewer 后面接可数名词复数。
“The more fast you run” 是正确比较级。
改写：If you take fewer bags, you move faster. → The fewer bags you take, the ____ you move.
改写：If we leave earlier, we get better seats. → The earlier we leave, the ____ seats we get.
补全：The more she practised the kick, the ____ it looked.
改错：The more languages he learns, more he travels.
exercises.answer: The more languages he learns, the more he travels.

exercises.q: 改错：The less cars, the better. （cars 可数）
The more you dump on a tired team, the ____ they can use.
exercises.explain: use 不可数概念用 less。

exercises.q: The harder the ice, the ____ the walk.
The more ____ she showed, the calmer the child became.
The sooner, ____.
The more familiar the melody became, the ____ she hummed it.
exercises.explain: the easier。也可 the more easily。此处 easier 作补语常见。

exercises.q: The more he thought about it, the ____ (angry) he became.
The fewer questions they asked, the ____ the report stayed.
The more ____ (carefully) he labelled, the faster the night shift found parts.
该结构可以用过去时描述当时的变化。
两个分句都必须用最高级来加强语气。
改写：As she waited longer, she grew more uneasy. → The longer she waited, the ____ she grew.
用 less：If you explain more loudly, they understand less. → The more loudly you explain, the ____ they understand.
省略：If we start sooner, it will be better. → The sooner, ____.
改错：The more patience she showed, the more calmer he felt.
exercises.answer: The more patience she showed, the calmer he felt.

exercises.q: 改错：The more you listen, the more easier it is.
exercises.answer: The more you listen, the easier it is.

exercises.q: The more files you hide, the ____ trust becomes.
The fewer inspectors a treaty has, the ____ it resembles paper.
The earlier the calibration, the ____ the dashboard.
The less shade a street keeps, the ____ its summers punish walkers.
The more ____ a team dumps, the less anyone can act.
The more assumptions you translate, the ____ the meeting becomes.
The later the apology, the ____ it sounds like procedure.
The fewer unpaid seats you offer, the ____ the room looks like a club.
the more 可以后接不可数名词。
学术写作禁止使用 The sooner, the better 这类省略。
改写：If you delay naming the leak, repairs cost more. → The longer you delay naming the leak, the ____ repairs cost.
改写：As public resources shrink, private luck looks more like talent. → The more public resources shrink, the more private luck ____ like talent.
If a map ignores more villages, it lies more. → The ____ villages a map ignores, the more it lies.
改错：The more you dump data, less they can use.
exercises.answer: The more data you dump, the less they can use.

exercises.q: 改错：The most early the inspectors arrive, the cleaner the files.
exercises.answer: The earlier the inspectors arrive, the cleaner the files.

exercises.q: The more a budget treats care as optional, the ____ the night rooms become.
The less enforcement moves, the ____ slogans achieve.
The more finely you round the totals, the ____ the neatness looks suspicious.
The fewer people who can reschedule their lives, the ____ inconvenience hides.
The longer silence lasts, the more it ____ as an answer.
The more access is gated, the more knowledge ____ (resemble) a park with a lock.
The earlier both maps lie on one table, the ____ the talks move.
The less a model of demand is recalibrated, the ____ it bankrupts a careful plan.
副词也可以进入该结构：the more carefully, the more easily。
两个分句的主语必须相同。
改写：As night deliveries continue, the street sleeps less. → The longer night deliveries continue, the ____ the street sleeps.
改写：If inspectors arrive earlier, files stay cleaner. → The earlier inspectors arrive, the ____ files stay.
补全：The more a city sells shade as decoration, ____ its summers punish walkers.
改错：The more finely you round, more suspicious the neatness looks.
exercises.answer: The more finely you round, the more suspicious the neatness looks.

exercises.q: 改错：The less people who can reschedule, the more easily inconvenience hides. （people 可数）
exercises.answer: The fewer people who can reschedule, the more easily inconvenience hides.

exercises.q: The more a footnote is buried, the more a reader ____ be forgiven for missing it.
The less a treaty is inspected, the more it ____ paper.
The more we mistake delay for peace, the ____ the next decade's bill.
The fewer assumptions get translated, the more terms ____ as if they agreed.
The more excellence is only repetition in costume, the ____ curiosity dies.
The more incentives and enforcement diverge, the ____ campaigns stall.
The less care a society funds now, the ____ it pays later.
