该结构的主句可以用 may / will / 一般现在时，取决于说话人把后果看成习惯还是预测。
“the more..., the more...” 不能带名词，只能带形容词。
exercises.explain: the more patience 完全合法。

exercises.q: 改写：As we sell access as privilege, knowledge looks more gated. → The more we sell access as privilege, the more gated knowledge ____.
改写：If you translate fewer assumptions, the meeting stays ruder. → The fewer assumptions you translate, the ____ the meeting stays.
省略评论：If they start the audit sooner, so much the better. 保留核心：The sooner, ____.
改错：The more a footnote is buried, the more may a reader be forgiven. （语序）
exercises.answer: The more a footnote is buried, the more a reader may be forgiven for missing it.

exercises.q: 改错：The less a treaty inspected, the more it remain paper.
exercises.answer: The less a treaty is inspected, the more it remains paper.

grammar.key: 'As long as' for Condition / 'As long as' 表示条件
grammar.title: as long as / so long as 表条件，兼辨 unless、provided that、as soon as、as far as
grammar.titleEn: As long as versus unless, provided that, as soon as, as far as
grammar.usage: as long as 引导条件状语从句，意为“只要”，强调该条件充分。从句用现在时表将来。近义 provided that, on condition that；对比 unless（否定条件）、as soon as（时间）、as far as（范围）。so long as 语体稍旧，意思接近。主句可用 can / will / 祈使。
forms: As long as + 现在时, 主句
主句 + as long as + 现在时
so long as（近义）
provided that / on condition that
对比：unless / if / as soon as / as far as
notes: as long as 从句通常不用 will。
不要和 as soon as（一……就）或 as far as（就……而言）混淆。
as long as 也可字面表示“长达……时间”，需靠语境区分。
只要条件成立，主句就成立，语气比 if 更强调“这一条就够了”。
否定可用 as long as you don't...。

examples.en: You can play as long as you finish dinner.
examples.cn: 只要吃完晚饭，你就可以玩。

examples.en: As long as the radio works, we can ask for a boat.
examples.cn: 只要无线电还能用，我们就能要船。

examples.en: As long as people get your meaning, the talk succeeds.
examples.cn: 只要别人懂你的意思，这次交谈就成功。

examples.en: You may publish as long as the raw files are posted.
examples.cn: 只要公布原始文件，你就可以发表。

examples.en: The night shift can leave as long as the labels are done.
examples.cn: 只要标签贴完，夜班就可以走。

examples.en: A street stays livable as long as shade is treated as infrastructure.
examples.cn: 只要把树荫当基础设施，街道就能宜居。

exercises.q: You can go out ____ you finish your milk.
As long as it ____ sunny, we will walk.
She may stay ____ she is quiet.
选择正确句子。
options: As long as you help, I am glad.
As long as you will help, I am glad.
As long you help, I am glad.
Long as you help, I glad.
exercises.answer: As long as you help, I am glad.

exercises.q: ____ long as the gate is closed, the goat is safe.
You can watch TV as long as you ____ (finish) homework.
As long as we ____ a torch, the path is fine.
He may play ____ long as it is not raining.
as long as 表示“只要”。
as long as 从句必须用 will。
用 as long as 连接：You are careful. You may hold the kitten. → You may hold the kitten ____ you are careful.
改成现在时：As long as it will be warm, we swim. → As long as it ____ warm, we will swim.
补全：____ long as the soup is hot, eat slowly.
改错：As long as you will finish, you can play.
exercises.answer: As long as you finish, you can play.

exercises.q: 改错：As soon as you are quiet, you may stay. （要表达只要安静）
exercises.answer: As long as you are quiet, you may stay.

exercises.q: As long as people can get your meaning, it ____ a successful talk.
You will be fine as long as you ____ a map.
____ you don't shout, the baby will sleep.
As far as I ____, the shop closes at eight.
exercises.explain: as far as 表范围，不是条件。

exercises.q: We can wait as long as the rain ____.
exercises.explain: 字面“长达”与条件交界，这里表持续条件。

exercises.q: As long as the ice ____ (look) thick, stay on it.
They may camp as long as they ____ (not light) a fire.
____ soon as the bell rings, we stand. （时间）
as far as I know 表示“就我所知”，不是“只要”。
so long as 与 as long as 意思相近。
用 as long as 改写：If you have internet, there are resources. → There are resources ____ you have internet.
换成 unless：As long as you lock it, it is safe. → It is not safe ____ you lock it.
辨：一到家就打电话用 ____ soon as。
改错：As long as you will have internet, there are videos.
exercises.answer: As long as you have internet, there are videos.

exercises.q: 改错：As far as you finish dinner, you can play. （要表达只要）
exercises.answer: As long as you finish dinner, you can play.

exercises.q: As long as you have a connection, there ____ tons of resources.
Communication succeeds as long as the other person ____ your meaning.
You may borrow it on condition that you ____ it by Friday.
exercises.explain: on condition that 同样用现在时。

exercises.q: So long as the radio ____, do not panic.
As soon as they ____ the hill, they called.
exercises.explain: as soon as 时间，可用过去。

exercises.q: You can teach online as long as both sides ____ (agree) on time.
Provided that the gate ____ (be) locked, the goats stay.
As long as you ____ (not ignore) the warning, you are safer.
on condition that 比 as long as 更正式。
as long as 不能放在句首。
用 provided that 改写：As long as you bring a torch, the path is safe. → Provided that you ____ a torch, the path is safe.
辨时间：他们一到山顶就打电话。They called ____ soon as they reached the hill.
用 so long as：只要不点火，就可以露营。You may camp ____ you don't light a fire.
exercises.answer: so long as / as long as

exercises.q: 改错：As long as you will agree on time, we teach.
exercises.answer: As long as you agree on time, we can teach.

exercises.q: 改错：On condition that you will return it, you may borrow it.
exercises.answer: On condition that you return it, you may borrow it.

exercises.q: You may publish as long as the raw files ____ posted.
The street remains livable as long as shade ____ as infrastructure.
As far as the archive ____ concerned, dusk is closing time.
exercises.explain: as far as ... is concerned 范围。

exercises.q: Inspectors can wait as long as the lab ____ sealed.
Unless the numbers are visible, the board ____ sign.
As long as both farms ____ (sign), the agreement holds.
You may delay the launch as long as the wind ____ (not drop) — wait, 要表达“只要风还没减弱就不要发射”：as long as the wind ____ high.
Care remains possible as long as wages ____ (move).
as long as 与 unless 一正一反，不能随便互换而不改主句极性。
as far as the archive is concerned 等于 as long as the archive is concerned。
用 as long as 改写：If the files are posted, you may publish. → You may publish ____ the files are posted.
用 unless 改写：As long as the lab stays sealed, we wait. → We will not enter ____ the lab is unsealed / unless it is unsealed.
范围：____ far as I can tell, the clause is incomplete.
改错：As long as the raw files will be posted, you may publish.
exercises.answer: As long as the raw files are posted, you may publish.

exercises.q: 改错：As far as shade is treated as infrastructure, the street stays livable. （要表达只要）
exercises.answer: As long as shade is treated as infrastructure, the street stays livable.

exercises.q: Campaigns work as long as incentives and enforcement ____ together.
The board will sign as long as it ____ the numbers.
So long as night deliveries continue, the street ____ sleep.
You can keep the title as long as you ____ not dress repetition as excellence.
On condition that inspectors ____ real access, the treaty lives.
As long as inconvenience hides behind those who cannot reschedule, the city ____ look efficient.
The dashboard can be trusted as long as sensors ____ (be) calibrated.
As far as funding ____ (be) concerned, care is still optional in the draft.
主句用 will、从句用现在时，仍然是 as long as 的标准搭配。
on condition that 从句必须用虚拟 were。
用 so long as 改写：As long as both maps lie on one table, talks progress. → Talks progress ____ both maps lie on one table.
exercises.answer: so long as / as long as

exercises.q: 辨范围：就预算而言，第二名护士请不起。____ far as the budget is concerned, a second nurse is unaffordable.
unless：As long as you post the files, trust holds. → Trust will not hold ____ you post the files.
改错：As long as incentives will move, campaigns work.
exercises.answer: As long as incentives move, campaigns work.

exercises.q: 改错：On condition that inspectors will have access, the treaty lives.
exercises.answer: On condition that inspectors have real access, the treaty lives.

exercises.q: A footnote may be missed as long as it ____ buried in the appendix.
Knowledge stays ungated as long as access ____ not sold as privilege.
The next decade will collect the bill as long as delay ____ for peace.
As far as inspectors ____ concerned, paper promises are insufficient.
exercises.explain: as far as sb are concerned。

exercises.q: The model holds only as long as demand ____ recalibrated.
exercises.explain: only as long as 强调唯一条件。

exercises.q: Society will pay later as long as it ____ (not fund) care now.
Terms will circulate as if they agreed as long as assumptions ____ (go) untranslated.
The plan survives as long as a small inconvenience ____ (not undo) the timeline — 用 does not undo。
only as long as 收紧了条件，暗示条件一旦消失主句立即不成立。
as long as 在学术英语中已被 provided that 完全取代，不能再出现。
用 only as long as 强调：The model works if demand is recalibrated, and not otherwise. → The model works ____ demand is recalibrated.
范围 vs 条件：就读者而言，脚注等于不存在。____ far as the reader is concerned, the footnote might as well not exist.
provided that：只要核查员有真实权限，条约才算活着。The treaty lives ____ inspectors have real access.
改错：As long as delay will be mistaken for peace, the bill grows.
exercises.answer: As long as delay is mistaken for peace, the bill will grow.

exercises.q: 改错：Knowledge stays ungated as far as access is not sold as privilege. （要表达只要）
exercises.answer: Knowledge stays ungated as long as access is not sold as privilege.

grammar.key: Comparative Structure: more and more / 比较结构：越来越……
grammar.title: 叠用比较级 more and more / -er and -er / less and less，兼辨 the more..., the more...
grammar.titleEn: Double comparatives: more and more, -er and -er, less and less
grammar.usage: 叠用比较级表示单一趋势越来越强：colder and colder / more and more difficult。只描述一个事物的变化，不像 the more..., the more... 连接两个比例变化。less and less 表递减。名词可用 more and more people。高中可与 become, grow, get 连用，或独立作状语。
forms: adj-er and adj-er（单音节）
more and more + adj/adv（多音节）
less and less + adj/n
more and more + 复数名词
get / become / grow + 比较级
notes: 不要写成 more and more colder。
单音节用 -er and -er：bigger and bigger。
与 the more..., the more... 不要混用两个句型的零件。
people 用 more and more people，不用 more and more person。
less and less 后接不可数或形容词，可数复数常用 fewer and fewer。

examples.en: The days are getting longer and longer.
examples.cn: 白天变得越来越长。

examples.en: English is becoming more and more useful to her.
examples.cn: 英语对她越来越有用。

examples.en: He felt less and less sure about the ice.
examples.cn: 他对冰面越来越没把握。

examples.en: More and more families choose night buses.
examples.cn: 越来越多家庭选择夜班车。

examples.en: The archive grew quieter and quieter after dusk.
examples.cn: 黄昏后档案馆越来越安静。

examples.en: Demand looks less and less like last year's model.
examples.cn: 需求越来越不像去年的模型。

exercises.q: The bag is getting ____.
The film is becoming ____ interesting.
Days are getting ____.
选择正确句子。
options: It is getting colder and colder.
It is getting cold and colderest.
It gets more and more colder.
exercises.answer: It is getting colder and colder.

exercises.q: She feels ____ tired after each hill.
The puppy is growing ____ (big).
The question is becoming more and more ____ (hard).
Nights are getting ____ (dark).
“more and more colder” 是正确的。
单音节常用 -er and -er。
改写：The soup is thicker now than before, and it keeps thickening. → The soup is getting ____.
改写：English is useful, and its usefulness is rising. → English is becoming ____ useful.
改成递减：He is more and more sure. → He is ____ sure.
改错：It is getting more and more colder.
exercises.answer: It is getting colder and colder.

exercises.q: 改错：The days are longer and more longer.
exercises.answer: The days are getting longer and longer.

exercises.q: Distance education is becoming ____.
____ people watch the night market.
The path grew ____ after the rain.
exercises.explain: 也可用 more and more slippery。

exercises.q: He made ____ mistakes after the rest.
Her voice became ____.
Online classes are becoming more and more ____ (common).
Fewer and fewer shops ____ (open) after nine.
The wait felt ____ (long).
fewer and fewer 后接可数复数。
“more and more person” 是正确搭配。
改写：Progress is not stopping. → Progress is not standing still; it is becoming ____ noticeable.
用 fewer：Mistakes are decreasing. → She makes ____ mistakes.
用 less：He has decreasing patience. → He has ____ patience.
改错：More and more person choose night buses.
exercises.answer: More and more people choose night buses.

exercises.q: 改错：He made less and less mistakes.
exercises.answer: He made fewer and fewer mistakes.

exercises.q: Face-to-face lessons are getting ____ for some families.
The melody grew ____ until everyone hummed it.
Resources online are becoming ____ ignored.
His explanations became ____.
____ contact through the Internet replaced the old letters.
Private teachers are becoming ____ (hard) to afford.
exercises.answer: harder and harder / more and more hard

exercises.q: The city feels ____ (quiet) after midnight.
She grew ____ (patient) with the slow computer.
become / get / grow 常与叠用比较级连用。
less and less 只能修饰名词，不能修饰形容词。
exercises.explain: less and less sure 很常见。

exercises.q: 改写：Knowing the song got easier every week. → The song became ____ to sing.
改写：Fewer families can afford that. → That is becoming ____ for families.
用 more and more + 名词：Online videos keep increasing. → There are ____ online videos.
改错：It became more and more easier.
改错：Less and less people wait at the old stop. （people 可数）
exercises.answer: Fewer and fewer people wait at the old stop.

exercises.q: Public support grew ____ after the lights stayed broken.
Unpaid internships look ____ exclusive.
The totals look ____ neat, which is itself a warning.
____ villages disappeared from the new bus map.
The dashboard's lies became ____ elegant.
Access is becoming ____ (gate) — 用 more and more gated。
Inspectors seem ____ (welcome) in the draft.
Night rooms are getting ____ (harsh).
分词形容词可以用 more and more：more and more gated。
more and more 与 the more..., the more... 可以拼成 The more and more you wait...。
改写：Trust is decreasing. → Trust is growing ____.
exercises.answer: thinner and thinner / less and less

exercises.q: 改写：The city treats shade as decoration increasingly. → Shade is treated ____ as decoration.
用 fewer：Quiet villages keep vanishing from the map. → ____ quiet villages remain on the map.
改错：The totals look more and more neater.
exercises.answer: The totals look neater and neater. / The totals look more and more neat.

exercises.q: 改错：More and more village disappeared.
Wages cannot stand still while rents climb ____.
Slogans achieve ____ when enforcement stalls.
The neatness of rounded figures looks ____ suspicious.
People who cannot reschedule their lives become ____ invisible in plans.
Curiosity dies ____ when mastery is only repetition.
Campaigns look ____ (hollow) without enforcement.
The street grows ____ (sleepless).
Raw files seem ____ (optional) in the draft, which is the problem.
get / grow / become / look / seem 都可以接叠用比较级。
faster and faster 必须改成 more and more fast。
改写：Delay is increasingly mistaken for peace. → Delay looks ____ like peace.
改写：The bill waiting in the next decade is growing. → The bill is getting ____.
递减：The treaty resembles living law less every year. → The treaty looks ____ like living law.
改错：Rents climb more and more higher.
改错：Slogans achieve fewer and fewer. （achieve 的宾语抽象）
A model unmoored from demand looks ____ like a careful plan.
Excellence dressed as repetition becomes ____ expensive to believe.
Footnotes migrate ____ into appendices nobody opens.
____ of what we call experience is only a pattern noticed just in time.
Public resources shrink, and private luck looks ____ like talent.
Inspectors appear ____ (ceremonial) in the newer drafts.
The gated-park metaphor fits ____ (tightly) each year.
exercises.answer: more and more tightly / tighter and tighter

exercises.q: Care deferred now returns ____ (harsh) later.
more and more of + 不可数/抽象名词 是合法的。
书面语必须用 increasingly 而不能用 more and more。
用 increasingly 改写：Access looks more and more like privilege. → Access looks ____ like privilege.
叠用：The appendix buries the footnote further each draft. → The footnote sinks ____ into the appendix.
fewer：Living clauses keep vanishing. → ____ living clauses remain.
改错：It looks more and more less like a plan.
exercises.answer: It looks less and less like a plan.

exercises.q: 改错：Harder and more harder to believe.

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense (with 'after') / 现在完成时（与'after'连用）
grammar.title: 现在完成时与 after/once/as soon as，兼 already/yet/for/since 与完成进行
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect after time conjunctions; already, yet, for, since
grammar.usage: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词，强调过去动作与现在的联系。在 after / when / once / as soon as 时间从句里，完成体突出“先完成再主句”。After they have gained enough knowledge, many people stop。对比一般过去：after they gained 也可，但完成体更强调完成性。高中：after having done 分词结构；现在完成进行 have been doing。
forms: have / has + 过去分词
after / when / once / as soon as + 现在完成时, 主句
already / yet / just / ever / never
for + 时段 / since + 起点
after having + 过去分词（分词短语）
have/has been + doing（完成进行）
notes: 时间从句里用现在完成代替将来完成：After I have eaten, I will go。不用 after I will have 在口语里也常简化。
already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
短暂动词可完成但不宜接 for 一段时间：不要 He has arrived for two hours，改用 been here。
after having done 更书面。
现在完成与一般过去常成对考：有具体过去时间用过去时。

examples.en: I have finished my soup.
examples.cn: 我已经喝完汤了。

examples.en: After she has packed, we can leave.
examples.cn: 她收拾好后我们就能走。

examples.en: Many people stop after they have gained enough of their mother tongue.
examples.cn: 许多人在母语够用之后就停止学习。

examples.en: Once the files have been posted, trust can return.
examples.cn: 文件一公布，信任就能回来。

examples.en: After having calibrated the sensors, they launched.
examples.cn: 校准传感器之后，他们才发射。

examples.en: She has been translating assumptions all morning.
examples.cn: 她一上午都在翻译那些前提。

exercises.q: She ____ finished her soup.
I ____ packed my bag.
After he ____ eaten, he will play.
选择正确句子。
We have not started ____.
Tom ____ (have) lost his key.
After she has ____ (wash) the cup, she will fill it.
I have ____ (just / arrive).
现在完成时由 have/has + 过去分词构成。
He have gone 是正确的。
改写：She finished. The bowl is empty now. → She ____ the soup.
After + 完成：He eats. Then he plays. → After he ____, he will play.
否定：They have started. → They have not started ____.
改错：She have finished.
改错：After he will eat, he plays.
exercises.answer: After he has eaten, he will play. / After he eats, he will play.

exercises.q: They stop after they ____ enough in their mother tongue.
____ you ever spoken to yourself in English?
She has already ____ the radio.
We have lived here ____ 2019.
He has been here ____ two hours. （不要用 arrived）
After they have ____ (lock) the gate, they leave.
I have not seen her ____ Monday.
____ you packed yet?
since 后接时间起点，for 后接时段。
“He has arrived for two hours” 比 “He has been here for two hours” 更自然。
用 after 完成体：They gain knowledge. Then they stop. → They stop after they ____ knowledge.
since：她从早上就在等。She ____ since morning.
already：We packed. → We have ____ packed.
改错：They has gained enough knowledge.
改错：He has arrived for two hours.
exercises.answer: He has been here for two hours. / He arrived two hours ago.

exercises.q: Once you ____ the warning, do not ignore it.
As soon as she has ____, we can sail.
Many learners stop after they have ____ their mother tongue “enough”.
exercises.explain: 完成。或 gained。此处 decided 也通。

exercises.q: I have never ____ a private teacher.
____ having packed, they waited for the ferry.
When the rain has ____ (stop), we will walk.
She has ____ (be) looking for online resources all week.
After they have gained enough, they ____ (stop).
after having done 是书面分词结构。
as soon as 后面不能用现在完成时。
用 once 完成：You read the warning. Then you follow it. → Once you ____ the warning, follow it.
完成进行：她一上午都在翻译。She ____ translating all morning.
after having：They calibrated. Then they launched. → After ____ the sensors, they launched.
改错：After they have gain enough, they stop.
exercises.answer: After they have gained enough, they stop.

exercises.q: 改错：Once you will have read it, follow it.
exercises.answer: Once you have read it, follow it.

exercises.q: Once the files have been ____, accusations fade.
After the sensors ____ calibrated, they launched.
exercises.explain: 过去的先后用过去完成也可。

exercises.q: The board has not signed ____.
Inspectors have waited ____ dawn.
She has been ____ assumptions into shared language.
After they have posted the raw files, trust ____ (return).
The clause has ____ (remain) paper because inspectors never arrived.
____ having sealed the lab, they waited for the green alarm.
时间从句里的现在完成可以指向将来已经完成的动作。
exercises.explain: After I have eaten, I will go。

exercises.q: 有明确过去时间 yesterday 时仍必须用现在完成。
被动完成：They post the files. Then we believe them. → After the files ____, we can believe them.
过去完成：The launch happened after calibration. → After the sensors ____ calibrated, they launched.
完成进行：一上午都在校准。They ____ the sensors all morning.
改错：After the files have posted, trust returns. （files 是受事）
exercises.answer: After the files have been posted, trust returns.

exercises.q: 改错：The board has signed yesterday.
exercises.explain: 具体过去时间用过去时。

exercises.q: Until the missing notebook ____, the investigation stood still.
As soon as both maps have ____ on one table, talks can move.
Night deliveries have continued ____ two sleepless winters.
We have already ____ the quieter villages; that is the complaint.
After having ____ the totals, they published a suspiciously neat page.
Once enforcement has ____ (move), slogans can mean something.
The street has not slept ____ night trucks arrived.
They have been ____ (hide) the delay rather than naming it.
lie（位于）的过去分词是 lain，不是 laid。
after having done 不能再带宾语。
exercises.explain: 可以 After having rounded the totals。

exercises.q: 用 once 被动：They recalibrate demand. Then the model lives. → Once demand ____, the model can live.
for/since：从两个冬天前夜班车就没停。Night deliveries have continued ____ two winters.
after having：They hid the delay. Then they lost the room. → After ____ the delay, they lost the room.
改错：As soon as both maps have laid on the table, talks move. （位于）
exercises.answer: As soon as both maps have lain on one table, talks can move.

exercises.q: 改错：We have ignored the villages last March.
exercises.answer: We ignored the villages last March.

exercises.q: After a society has ____ care, it still pays, only later.
Once access has been ____ as privilege, knowledge looks gated.
The footnote has ____ in the appendix for three drafts.
Inspectors have yet ____ real access.
Having ____ assumptions, they found the disagreement was never about terms.
Until delay has been ____ (name), it will keep passing as peace.
The treaty has remained paper since inspectors ____ (be) denied entry.
She has been ____ (mistake) delay for peace — 用 mistaking。
have yet to do 表示尚未发生，语气正式。
Having done 开头的分词短语，其逻辑主语必须是主句主语。
have yet to：核查员仍未获得权限。Inspectors ____ real access.
exercises.answer: have yet to be given / have yet to receive

exercises.q: after 完成被动：Society defers care. Later it pays. → After care ____, society still pays later.
分词：They translated assumptions. They saw the real fight. → ____ assumptions, they saw the real fight.
改错：The footnote has laid in the appendix for three drafts.
exercises.answer: The footnote has lain in the appendix for three drafts.

exercises.q: 改错：Having translated assumptions, the disagreement was about values. （悬垂）
exercises.answer: Having translated assumptions, they found the disagreement was about values.

grammar.title: nor / neither 部分倒装，兼 so、否定副词与 not until / only after
grammar.titleEn: Inversion after nor, neither, never, not until, only after
grammar.usage: nor 连接另一否定句且需部分倒装：Nor + 助动词/be/情态 + 主语。前句须有否定或准否定（few, never, hardly）。neither 用法接近；so 用于肯定倒装：So do I。neither...nor... 并列结构不一定倒装。高中：Nor was there easy access；否定副词句首倒装 Never have I...
forms: Nor + 助动词/be/情态 + 主语 + 其他
Neither + 助动词 + 主语
So + 助动词 + 主语（肯定附和）
neither... nor...（并列，不一定倒装）
Never / Seldom / Hardly + 助动词 + 主语（否定副词倒装）
notes: nor 后不要再加 not。
助动词必须提前：Nor was there... 不是 Nor there was。
前句若是 there be 否定，后句常 nor was there。
neither 可单独倒装：I don't. Neither do I。
并列 neither A nor B 作主语时谓语就近或按习惯用单数，视语体。

examples.en: I don't like cold soup, nor does my brother.
examples.cn: 我不喜欢冷汤，我弟弟也不喜欢。

examples.en: There was no torch, nor was there a spare battery.
examples.cn: 没有手电筒，也没有备用电池。

examples.en: She has never been late, nor has she missed a call.
examples.cn: 她从未迟到，也从未漏接电话。

examples.en: There were few online classes; nor was there easy access to files.
examples.cn: 几乎没有在线课，也没有方便的文件通道。

examples.en: Never have they posted the raw files.
examples.cn: 他们从未公布过原始文件。

examples.en: Neither the clause nor the appendix mentions inspectors.
examples.cn: 条款和附录都没提核查员。

exercises.q: I don't swim, nor ____ my sister.
He isn't hungry, nor ____ I.
They can't come, nor ____ we.
选择正确句子。
options: She doesn't run, nor does Tom.
She doesn't run, nor Tom does.
She doesn't run, nor not Tom.
exercises.answer: She doesn't run, nor does Tom.

exercises.q: I like tea. ____ does she.
I don't eat fish, nor ____ (do) my dad.
We aren't ready, nor ____ they.
He can't skate, nor ____ she.
nor 后面要倒装。
I don't. So do I. 是正确的否定附和。
附和否定：Mia doesn't dance. Tom doesn't dance. → Mia doesn't dance, ____ Tom.
肯定附和：I like rain. She likes rain. → I like rain, ____ she.
补助动词：He isn't tired, nor ____ I.
改错：I don't swim, nor my sister does.
exercises.answer: I don't swim, nor does my sister.

exercises.q: 改错：She can't come, nor can not he.
exercises.answer: She can't come, nor can he.

exercises.q: There was no key, nor ____ there a spare.
We have no map, nor ____ we a compass.
exercises.explain: 实义 have 可用 do；nor have we 亦可，本题选 do。

exercises.q: She never shouts, nor ____ she slam doors.
I didn't wait. ____ did they.
There were few buses, nor ____ the shop open.
There is no lift, nor ____ there a ramp.
He hasn't called, nor ____ he written.
They weren't hungry, nor ____ we.
前句有 few 时，后句仍可用 nor 倒装。
nor 后面再加 not 可以加强否定。
改写：No torch. No battery. → There was no torch, ____ a spare battery.
neither：I didn't go. She didn't go. → I didn't go, ____ she.
there be：No online class. No easy access. → There were no online classes; nor ____ easy access.
改错：There was no torch, nor there was a battery.
exercises.answer: There was no torch, nor was there a battery.

exercises.q: 改错：He never shouts, nor he does slam doors.
exercises.answer: He never shouts, nor does he slam doors.

exercises.q: There were few videos; nor ____ there easy access to information.
She couldn't afford that, nor ____ her neighbours.
Never ____ I seen the river so low.
He speaks neither French ____ Spanish.
Seldom ____ the night market close before ten.
Nor ____ there an affordable teacher in the valley.
Hardly ____ they started when the rain returned.
exercises.explain: hardly 倒装常用过去完成。

exercises.q: Neither distance education nor private lessons ____ (be) free.
Never/Seldom/Hardly 位于句首时要部分倒装。
neither...nor... 连接主语时必须倒装整个句子。
用 nor 连接：Few online classes existed. Easy access did not exist. → There were few online classes; ____ easy access.
Never 倒装：I have never afforded a private teacher. → Never ____ a private teacher.
neither...nor：He doesn't have time or money. → He has neither time ____ money.
改错：Nor there was easy access.
改错：Never I have seen the river so low.
exercises.answer: Never have I seen the river so low.

exercises.q: The board did not see the numbers, nor ____ it ask for them.
Rarely ____ the draft mention inspectors.
Neither the clause nor the appendix ____ inspectors.
No raw files were posted, nor ____ any explanation offered.
So fragile ____ the trust that one delay undid it.
Nor ____ the quieter villages appear on the map.
Under no circumstances ____ we seal the lab without the alarm.
They have not calibrated the sensors, nor ____ they checked the dashboard.
Under no circumstances 句首要倒装。
so + adj + 倒装 只用于疑问句。
nor 被动：No explanation was offered. → ..., nor ____ any explanation offered.
rarely：The draft rarely mentions inspectors. → Rarely ____ inspectors.
neither nor：The clause doesn't mention them. The appendix doesn't. → Neither the clause nor the appendix ____ them.
改错：Nor the board did ask for the numbers.
exercises.answer: Nor did the board ask for the numbers.

exercises.q: 改错：Rarely the draft does mention inspectors.
exercises.answer: Rarely does the draft mention inspectors.

exercises.q: Wages have not moved, nor ____ rents paused.
Little ____ they know that the map was already obsolete.
No sooner had the files been requested ____ the lab sealed itself.
Neither incentives nor enforcement ____ in the current draft.
Not only was the street sleepless, ____ the air smelled of diesel till dawn.
exercises.explain: not only 倒装后接 but。

exercises.q: Hardly had night deliveries stopped ____ residents slept.
Nor ____ shade treated as infrastructure.
Seldom ____ a slogan replace missing inspectors.
no sooner 与过去完成连用，后接 than。
little 位于句首且表否定时要倒装。
little 倒装：They little knew the map was obsolete. → Little ____ the map was obsolete.
no sooner：The files were requested. Then the lab sealed. → No sooner had the files been requested ____ the lab sealed.
nor 被动：Shade was not treated as infrastructure. → ..., nor ____ shade treated as infrastructure.
改错：No sooner the files had been requested than the lab sealed.
exercises.answer: No sooner had the files been requested than the lab sealed.

exercises.q: 改错：Little they knew that the map was obsolete.
exercises.answer: Little did they know that the map was obsolete.

exercises.q: Nowhere in the treaty ____ inspectors granted real access.
Not until the next decade ____ the bill arrive.
Barely had the footnote been moved ____ readers stopped looking.
Neither paper promises nor ceremonial visits ____ a living clause.
exercises.explain: 复数概念；就近 visits 也可用 make。

exercises.q: Only after assumptions were translated ____ the real disagreement appear.
Nor ____ delay be mistaken for peace without cost.
Scarcely had care been deferred ____ harsher rooms filled.
Not a single raw file ____ (be) posted, nor was an explanation offered.
only after / not until 置于句首时，主句倒装。
nowhere 倒装时谓语仍要与真正主语一致。
not until 倒装：The bill will arrive only in the next decade. → Not until the next decade ____ the bill arrive.
only after：The disagreement appeared only after they translated assumptions. → Only after assumptions were translated ____ the disagreement appear.
nowhere：Inspectors are granted real access nowhere in the treaty. → Nowhere in the treaty ____ inspectors granted real access.
改错：Not until the next decade the bill will arrive.
exercises.answer: Not until the next decade will the bill arrive.

exercises.q: 改错：Only after assumptions were translated the disagreement appeared.
exercises.answer: Only after assumptions were translated did the disagreement appear.

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Condition with 'as long as' / 由条件连词扩展：unless / only if / otherwise
grammar.title: unless、only if、otherwise / or else 与 if not 省略，极性与倒装
grammar.titleEn: Unless, only if, otherwise, or else, and elliptical if not
grammar.usage: unless 表示“除非”，相当于 if ... not，但语气更强调例外条件。从句用现在时表将来。不要与 as long as 的极性搞反。otherwise / or else 用在主句后表否则。only if 条件更严，主句有时倒装：Only if you lock it will they stay。if not 可作省略：If not, wait。
forms: Unless + 现在时, 主句
If + not / don't + 现在时, 主句
主句 + otherwise / or else + 结果
only if + 从句（主句可倒装）
If not, + 祈使/将来
notes: unless 已含否定，通常不再加 don't。
as long as 是正面充分条件，unless 是例外门槛。
only if 比 if 更窄：只有在该条件下才发生。
otherwise 是副词，不是连词带从句：Leave now; otherwise you will miss it。
虚拟 If I were you 不能简单换成 unless I were you 而不改意思。

examples.en: Unless you lock the gate, the goats will leave.
examples.cn: 除非锁门，山羊会跑。

examples.en: We will wait unless the rain stops.
examples.cn: 除非雨停，否则我们就等。

examples.en: Hurry up, or else you will miss the ferry.
examples.cn: 快点，否则你会误船。

examples.en: Only if both farms sign will the agreement hold.
examples.cn: 只有两家农场都签字，协议才成立。

examples.en: Calibrate the sensors; otherwise the dashboard will lie.
examples.cn: 校准传感器，否则仪表会说谎。

examples.en: The treaty remains paper unless inspectors have real access.
examples.cn: 除非核查员有真实权限，否则条约仍是纸。

exercises.q: ____ you hurry, you will miss the bus.
Unless it ____ sunny, take a coat.
Lock the gate, ____ the goats will leave.
选择正确句子。
options: Unless you lock it, they will leave.
Unless you don't lock it, they will leave.
Unless you will lock it, they leave.
exercises.answer: Unless you lock it, they will leave.

exercises.q: If you ____ water it, it will die.
Unless she ____ (run), she will miss it.
Take a map, or you ____ get lost.
We will stay inside unless it ____ (stop).
unless 相当于 if ... not。
Unless you don't hurry 是最自然的。
用 unless 改写：If you don't lock it, they leave. → Unless you ____ it, they will leave.
用 or：Hurry. You will miss it. → Hurry, ____ you will miss it.
if not 省略：If it is not sunny, take a coat. → If ____, take a coat.
改错：Unless you will hurry, you miss it.
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss it.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless you don't lock it, the goats stay. （要表达除非锁上）
exercises.answer: Unless you lock it, the goats will leave.

exercises.q: You will not improve unless you ____ keen.
Bring a torch; ____ the path is unsafe.
Only if you ____ a ticket can you enter.
We can sail unless the wind ____ up.
Finish this, or else we ____ wait till night.
Unless people ____ (get) your meaning, the talk fails.
Wear a helmet; otherwise you ____ at risk.
Only if it ____ (stop) raining will we walk.
otherwise 后面直接接句子，前面常用分号或句号。
only if 不能引起主句倒装。
unless 改写：If you don't stay keen, it will not happen. → Unless you ____ keen, it will not happen.
otherwise：Calibrate it. If not, it will lie. → Calibrate it; ____ it will lie.
only if：You can enter only if you have a ticket. → Only if you have a ticket ____ you enter.
改错：Unless you will stay keen, it happens.
exercises.answer: Unless you stay keen, it will not happen. / Unless you stay keen, it isn't going to happen.

exercises.q: 改错：Otherwise you don't bring a torch, the path is unsafe.
exercises.answer: If you don't bring a torch, the path is unsafe. / Bring a torch; otherwise the path is unsafe.

exercises.q: Distance education will stall unless someone ____ on Thursdays.
You cannot afford that unless prices ____.
Post the files, or else trust ____.
Only if the radio ____ can we ask for a boat.
If not ____ today, the ferry leaves without us.
Unless the ice ____ (look) thick, stay off it.
Say the meaning again; otherwise nobody ____ you.
Only if you ____ (have) internet will the videos load.
If not + 过去分词 可以省略主语和 be。
unless 从句表将来时要用 will。
unless：If nobody answers on Thursday, it stalls. → It will stall unless someone ____ on Thursday.
or else：Post the files. Trust will thin if you don't. → Post the files, ____ trust will thin.
If not 省略：If it is not booked today, the ferry leaves. → If ____ today, the ferry leaves without us.
改错：Unless prices will fall, you cannot afford that.
exercises.answer: Unless prices fall, you cannot afford that.

exercises.q: 改错：Only if the radio will work we can ask.
exercises.answer: Only if the radio works can we ask for a boat.

exercises.q: The board will not sign unless it ____ the numbers.
Name the delay; otherwise the room ____ you.
Only if raw files ____ posted will trust return.
The sheds will flood unless the river ____.
If not ____ by dusk, the archive closes on the unfinished pile.
Unless inspectors ____ (arrive), the clause is paper.
Calibrate the sensors; otherwise the dashboard ____.
Only if both farms ____ (sign) will the agreement hold.
only if 置于句首时，主句常用部分倒装。
unless 与 as long as 在不改主句的情况下可以互换。
unless 被动：If the files are not posted, trust thins. → Trust will thin unless the files ____.
otherwise：See the numbers. If you don't, don't sign. → See the numbers; ____ don't sign.
only if 倒装：Trust returns only if files are posted. → Only if files are posted ____ trust return.
改错：Unless the board will see the numbers, it signs.
exercises.answer: Unless the board sees the numbers, it will not sign.

exercises.q: 改错：Only if files are posted trust will return.
exercises.answer: Only if files are posted will trust return.

exercises.q: Campaigns stall unless enforcement ____.
Treat shade as infrastructure; otherwise summers ____ walkers.
Only if both maps ____ on one table will talks progress.
Wages cannot stand still unless rents ____ climbing.
If not ____, inconvenience hides behind those who cannot reschedule.
Unless incentives ____ (move) with enforcement, slogans hollow out.
Post raw files, or else accusations of neatness ____.
Only if night deliveries ____ (stop) will the street sleep.
or else 与 otherwise 都可表否则，但 or else 更口语。
If not + 过去分词 必须补出主语。
unless：If enforcement does not move, campaigns stall. → Campaigns stall unless enforcement ____.
only if 倒装：Talks progress only if both maps lie on one table. → Only if both maps lie on one table ____ talks progress.
otherwise：Stop night deliveries. If you don't, the street will not sleep. → Stop night deliveries; ____ the street will not sleep.
改错：Unless enforcement will move, campaigns work.
exercises.answer: Unless enforcement moves, campaigns stall. / Unless enforcement moves, campaigns will stall.

exercises.q: 改错：Only if both maps will lie on one table talks progress.
exercises.answer: Only if both maps lie on one table will talks progress.

exercises.q: A treaty remains paper unless inspectors ____ real access.
Fund care now; otherwise the next decade ____ the bill.
Only if assumptions ____ translated will terms stop pretending to agree.
The model bankrupts the plan unless demand ____.
If not ____ as privilege, access still looks like a public path.
Unless delay ____ (be) named, it will keep passing as peace.
Translate assumptions, or else you ____ only swap terms.
Only if the footnote ____ (leave) the appendix will readers find it.
unless 可以带被动现在时，表示例外条件未满足则主句成立。
only if 倒装时，从句也必须倒装。
unless 被动：If demand is not recalibrated, the model fails. → The model fails unless demand ____.
only if 倒装：Terms stop pretending only if assumptions are translated. → Only if assumptions are translated ____ terms stop pretending to agree.
If not：If access is not sold as privilege, it looks public. → If ____ as privilege, access still looks public.
改错：Unless inspectors will have access, the treaty lives.
exercises.answer: Unless inspectors have real access, the treaty remains paper.

exercises.q: 改错：Only if assumptions are translated terms will stop pretending.
exercises.answer: Only if assumptions are translated will terms stop pretending to agree.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语（扩展：not only... but also...）
grammar.title: not only... but also... 平行结构与句首倒装，呼应动名词主语长句
grammar.titleEn: Not only... but also... with parallelism and inversion
grammar.usage: not only... but also... 连接对等成分，强调两者都成立。Knowing a language not only helps you express yourself but also helps you improve。not only 位于句首时，前一分句部分倒装：Not only did they post the files, but they also explained them。but also 中 also 可省。近义 as well as（重心在前项）。高中：not only 倒装 + 时态一致；连接主语时谓语就近。
forms: 主语 + not only + 动词, but also + 动词
not only + 名词 + but also + 名词
Not only + 助动词 + 主语..., but (also)...（句首倒装）
as well as（近义，重心不同）
both... and...（两者同等，不倒装）
notes: 前后语法形式要平行：都是名词、或都是动词、或都是从句。
句首 Not only 倒装的是前半，but also 后不倒装。
连接主语时谓语常与最近主语一致。
不要写成 not only... and also 或 but also... too 叠床架屋。
as well as 重心在前面一项，谓语跟前面主语。

examples.en: She not only sings but also draws.
examples.cn: 她不仅唱歌，还画画。

examples.en: The stall sells not only fruit but also tea.
examples.cn: 摊位不仅卖水果，还卖茶。

examples.en: Knowing a language not only helps you speak but also helps you think.
examples.cn: 懂一门语言不仅帮你说话，也帮你思考。

examples.en: Not only did they post the files, but they also explained the gaps.
examples.cn: 他们不仅公布了文件，还解释了缺口。

examples.en: The flood damaged not only shops but also the basement records.
examples.cn: 洪水不仅冲了店铺，还毁了地下室档案。

examples.en: A public space serves not only leisure but also unplanned talk.
examples.cn: 公共空间不仅服务休闲，还服务不期而遇的谈话。

exercises.q: She not only sings ____ also dances.
He not only runs but also ____.
They sell not only bread but also ____.
选择正确句子。
options: She not only sings but also draws.
She not only sings but draws also too.
She not only sings and also draws.
She not only sing but also draws.
exercises.answer: She not only sings but also draws.

exercises.q: I not only packed but also ____ the lights.
He not only reads but also ____ (write).
We need not only cups ____ also plates.
She not only ____ (help) me but also waited.
not only... but also... 连接的两部分形式要一样。
She not only sing 是正确的。
连接：She sings. She draws. → She not only sings ____ draws.
名词：They sell fruit and tea. → They sell not only fruit ____ tea.
补动词：He not only packed but also ____ (lock) the door.
改错：She not only sings and also draws.
exercises.answer: She not only sings but also draws.

exercises.q: 改错：He not only run but also swims.
exercises.answer: He not only runs but also swims.

exercises.q: Knowing a language not only helps you speak but also ____ you learn.
The course offers not only videos but also ____.
Not only ____ she finish, but she also helped us.
He is not only tired but also ____.
They not only practised pronunciation but also ____ phrases.
Not only ____ (do) they wait, but they also queued again.
It not only saves time but also ____ (save) money.
She invited not only Tom but also ____ (he).
not only 放句首时前一分句要倒装。
but also 后面也要倒装。
exercises.explain: 只倒装 not only 部分。

exercises.q: 倒装：She finished, and she helped. → Not only ____ she finish, but she also helped.
课文：Knowing a language helps you express yourself and improve. → Knowing a language not only helps you express yourself ____ helps you improve.
as well as：She sings and draws. → She sings ____ draws. （重心在 sings）
改错：Not only she did finish, but she also helped.
exercises.answer: Not only did she finish, but she also helped.

exercises.q: 改错：He is not only tired but also hungrily.
exercises.answer: He is not only tired but also hungry.

exercises.q: Distance education is not only cheaper but also ____.
Not only ____ there few classes, but access was also poor.
The Internet not only carries lessons but also ____ inconvenience.
She improved not only her pronunciation but also her ____.
Both patience ____ practice matter.
Not only ____ (have) they gained a mother tongue, but they also stopped too early.
It goes without saying that face-to-face work is not only warmer but also ____ (clear).
The app helps you not only listen but also ____ (speak).
both...and... 不倒装。
there be 句在 Not only 后同样倒装。
倒装 there be：There were few classes, and access was poor. → Not only ____ few classes, but access was also poor.
平行名词：He improved pronunciation and attitude. → He improved not only pronunciation ____ attitude.
both and：Patience matters. Practice matters. → Both patience ____ practice matter.
改错：Not only there were few classes, but access was poor.
exercises.answer: Not only were there few classes, but access was also poor.

exercises.q: 改错：The Internet not only carries lessons but also reducing inconvenience.
exercises.answer: The Internet not only carries lessons but also reduces inconvenience.

exercises.q: Knowing a language not only helps you express yourself but also ____ you to improve yourself.
Not only ____ the files posted, but the gaps were explained.
The delay damaged not only the timetable but also ____.
Inspectors need not only access but also ____.
As well as posting files, they ____ a note.
exercises.explain: as well as 重心在 wrote? 实际 as well as posting, they wrote — 谓语跟 they。

exercises.q: Not only ____ (do) the dashboard lie, but it lied elegantly.
The map ignored not only villages but also ____ (they) paths.
Public space serves leisure as well as ____ (talk).
as well as 的谓语通常跟前面的主语，而不是 as well as 后面的名词。
Not only 倒装后，but also 分句要把助动词再提前一次。
倒装被动：The files were posted, and the gaps were explained. → Not only ____ the files posted, but the gaps were also explained.
课文动名词主语：Knowing a language helps you express yourself and improve. → Knowing a language not only helps you express yourself ____ helps you improve.
as well as：They posted files and wrote a note. → They wrote a note as well as ____ files.
改错：Not only the files were posted, but the gaps were explained.
exercises.answer: Not only were the files posted, but the gaps were also explained.

exercises.q: 改错：Knowing a language not only help you speak but also helps you think.
exercises.answer: Knowing a language not only helps you speak but also helps you think.

exercises.q: Night deliveries not only steal sleep but also ____ the air.
Not only ____ wages frozen, but rents kept climbing.
The draft offers neither inspectors ____ real access.
Campaigns need not only slogans but also ____.
Not only did they round the totals, ____ they also buried the method.
Not only ____ (have) shade been treated as decoration, but summers have punished walkers.
The street lost not only quiet but also ____ (safe) crossings.
They failed not only to post files but also to ____ (explain) the gaps.
not only to do but also to do 保持不定式平行。
neither...nor... 与 not only...but also... 可以在同一层随意混用。
倒装：Shade has been treated as decoration, and summers have punished walkers. → Not only ____ shade been treated as decoration, but summers have also punished walkers.
不定式平行：They failed to post and to explain. → They failed not only to post files but also ____ the gaps.
名词：Campaigns need slogans and enforcement. → Campaigns need not only slogans ____ enforcement.
改错：Not only wages were frozen, but rents kept climbing.
exercises.answer: Not only were wages frozen, but rents kept climbing.

exercises.q: A living treaty needs not only signatures but also ____.
Not only ____ delay been mistaken for peace, but the bill has been postponed.
The appendix not only buries the footnote but also ____ the reader.
Excellence is not only repetition in costume but also ____ curiosity.
Not only must assumptions be translated, ____ terms must stop pretending.
Not only ____ (do) access get sold as privilege, but knowledge starts to look gated.
They translated not only terms but also ____ (assume).
The next decade will collect not only money but also ____ (harsh) rooms.
情态动词位于 Not only 后同样倒装：Not only must we...。
but also 可以换成 but... as well，后半仍不倒装。
情态倒装：Assumptions must be translated, and terms must stop pretending. → Not only ____ assumptions be translated, but terms must also stop pretending.
完成被动：Delay has been mistaken for peace, and the bill has been postponed. → Not only ____ delay been mistaken for peace, but the bill has also been postponed.
名词平行：A treaty needs signatures and inspectors. → A treaty needs not only signatures ____ inspectors.
改错：Not only delay has been mistaken for peace, but the bill has been postponed.
exercises.answer: Not only has delay been mistaken for peace, but the bill has also been postponed.
